title.zh: 卷七 本紀第七: 世宗中
title.raw: 卷七 本紀第七: 世宗中 Volume 7 Annals 7: Shizong 2

sentences.zh: 十二年正月庚午朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year 12, first month, on gengwu the new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12, on the gengwu new moon of the first month, congratulatory envoys arrived from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔有司：「凡陳言文字，皆國政利害，自今言有可行，以其本封送秘書監，當行者錄副付所司。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict to the responsible offices: “All memorial texts bear on the benefit and harm of state policy; from now on, when a proposal is feasible, send the original sealed to the Directorate of Archives; what should be carried out—record a copy and deliver it to the responsible office.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the throne ordered the ministries: “Every memorial touches the weal or woe of the realm. Henceforth, when a proposal can be acted on, send the sealed original to the Directorate of Archives; for measures to be executed, file a copy with the office in charge.

sentences.zh: 」丙申，以水旱，免中都、西京、南京、河北、河東、山東、陝西去年租稅。

translations.literal: ” On bingshen, because of flood and drought, last year’s land tax and levies were remitted in the Central Capital, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Hebei, Hedong, Shandong, and Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingshen flood and drought won remission of the previous year’s taxes across the Central Capital, Western Capital, Southern Capital, Hebei, Hedong, Shandong, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 二月壬寅，上召諸王府長史諭之曰：「朕選汝等，正欲勸導諸王，使之為善。

translations.literal: Second month, on renyin, the emperor summoned the chief administrators of the princely establishments and instructed them: “I chose you precisely to guide and counsel the princes, to make them do good.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renyin, he called in the chief stewards of the princely houses and said: “I picked you to guide the princes toward what is right.

sentences.zh: 如諸王所為有所未善，當力陳之，尚或不從，則具某日行某事以奏。

translations.literal: If the princes’ conduct has anything not good, you should press to state it; if still they do not obey, then detail on what day they did what and memorialize.
translations.idiomatic: When a prince errs, speak plainly; if he will not listen, set down the day and deed and report it up.

sentences.zh: 若阿意不言，朕惟汝罪。

translations.literal: If you flatter and do not speak, I will hold only you guilty.
translations.idiomatic: Flatter in silence, and the fault is yours alone.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，尚書省奏，廉察到同知城陽軍事山和尚等清強官，上曰：「此輩暗察明訪皆著政聲，可第其政績，各進官旌賞。

translations.literal: ” On bingwu the Secretariat memorialized that integrity inspectors had found Vice Commissioner of Chengyang Military Affairs Shan Heshang and others to be upright, forceful officials; the emperor said: “These men, in secret inspection and open inquiry, all have distinguished administrative reputations; rank their political achievements and advance each in office with commendation and reward.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingwu the Secretariat reported that inspectors had singled out Shan Heshang of Chengyang and others as upright, capable men. The emperor said: “Whether they probe in shadow or in daylight, these officers leave a name for good government. Rank their records and promote them with honors.

sentences.zh: 其速議升除。

translations.literal: Have them quickly deliberate promotions.
translations.idiomatic: See that promotions are settled at once.

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，上如順州春水。

translations.literal: ” On gengxu the emperor went to Shunzhou for spring ice-fishing.
translations.idiomatic: ” On gengxu he went to Shunzhou for the spring ice-fish hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，還都。

translations.literal: On guichou, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔：「自今官長不法，其僚佐不能糾正又不言上者，並坐之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, an edict: “From now on, when a chief official acts unlawfully, if his subordinates cannot correct him and also do not report upward, they will be punished together.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen an edict ran: “Hereafter, when a chief breaks the law, any subordinate who neither corrects him nor reports upward shares the penalty.

sentences.zh: 」戶部尚書高德基濫支朝官俸錢四十萬貫，杖八十。

translations.literal: ” Minister of Revenue Gao Deji had improperly disbursed forty myriad strings of court officials’ salary cash and received eighty strokes of the staff.
translations.idiomatic: ” Minister of Revenue Gao Deji, who had paid out four hundred thousand strings of officials’ salaries without warrant, was beaten eighty strokes.

sentences.zh: 三月己巳朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on jisi the new moon, Wan Spring Festival: Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the third month, at the Wan Spring Festival, congratulatory envoys came from Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔尚書省：「贓汙之官，已被廉問，若仍舊職，必復害民。

translations.literal: On yihai, an edict to the Secretariat: “Corrupt officials who have already been investigated by integrity inspectors—if they remain in their old posts, they will surely harm the people again.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he ordered the Secretariat: “Officials proved corrupt by inspection must not keep their old posts, or the people will suffer again.

sentences.zh: 其遣使諸道，即日罷之。

translations.literal: Send envoys to all circuits to dismiss them that very day.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch envoys to every circuit and remove them the same day.

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，詔遣宿直將軍烏古論思列，冊封王皓為高麗國王。

translations.literal: ” On dingchou an edict dispatched standing-duty General Wugulun Silie to invest and enfeoff Wang Hao as King of Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: ” On dingchou he sent standing-duty General Wugulun Silie to invest Wang Hao as King of Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，雨土。

translations.literal: On gengyin, earth rained from the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin dust fell from the sky.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以前西北路招討使移剌道為參知政事。

translations.literal: On guisi, former Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dao was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi former Northwest Route pacification commissioner Yelü Dao became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 回紇遣使來貢。

translations.literal: The Uighurs sent envoys to offer tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The Uighurs sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，北京曹貴等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On dingyou, Cao Gui and others of the Northern Capital plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Cao Gui and his fellows at the Northern Capital plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 五月癸酉，上如百花川。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on guiwei, the emperor went to Baihua Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on guiwei, he went to Baihua Stream.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，命賑山東東路胡剌溫猛安民饑。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, he ordered relief for famine among the people of the Hulawen meng’an in Shandong East Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu he ordered grain relief for the starving at the Hulawen meng’an in Shandong East Circuit.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，次阻居。

translations.literal: On dingchou, he halted at Zuju.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he halted at Zuju.

sentences.zh: 久旱而雨。

translations.literal: After long drought, rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: Rain came after a long drought.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，觀稼。

translations.literal: On wuyin, he inspected the crops.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he went out to inspect the crops.

sentences.zh: 禁扈從蹂踐民田。

translations.literal: The entourage was forbidden to trample the people’s fields.
translations.idiomatic: He forbade the entourage to trample civilian fields.

sentences.zh: 禁百官及承應人不得服純黃油衣。

translations.literal: Officials and attendants were forbidden to wear pure yellow oiled-cloth garments.
translations.idiomatic: Officials and attendants were forbidden to wear garments of pure yellow oiled cloth.

sentences.zh: 癸未，諭宰臣曰：「朕每次舍，凡就秣馬之具皆假於民間，多亡失不還其主。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he instructed the chief ministers: “Every time I lodge, all foddering gear for the horses is borrowed from the populace; much is lost and not returned to its owners.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he told the chief ministers: “At every halt, the gear we borrow from common folk to feed the horses is often lost and never returned.

sentences.zh: 此彈壓官不職，可擇人代之。

translations.literal: These suppression officers are derelict—someone may be chosen to replace them.
translations.idiomatic: The circuit suppression officers are failing in duty—choose men to replace them.

sentences.zh: 所過即令詢問，但亡失民間什物，並償其直。

translations.literal: Wherever we pass, immediately order inquiries; for any lost civilian goods, compensate the full value.
translations.idiomatic: Wherever we pass, inquire at once; for anything the people lose, pay full value.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，詔給西北路人戶牛。

translations.literal: ” On yiyou, an edict supplied cattle to northwest route households.
translations.idiomatic: ” On yiyou an edict granted cattle to households on the northwest route.

sentences.zh: 六月甲寅，如金蓮川。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on jiayin, he went to Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on jiayin, he went to Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on bingzi, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on bingzi, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以右副都點檢來穀清臣等為賀宋生日使，右衛將軍粘割斡特剌為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Right Deputy Metropolitan Inspector Laigu Qingchen and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday; Right Guard General Zhanci Wotelie was made envoy for Western Xia’s imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Laigu Qingchen, right deputy metropolitan inspector, and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; Right Guard General Zhanci Wotelie was sent to Western Xia for the same rite.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，太白晝見，在日前。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Great White star was seen in daylight, before the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Venus shone by day, standing before the sun.

sentences.zh: 鄜州李方等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: At Fuzhou, Li Fang and others plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: At Fuzhou Li Fang and his fellows plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十月，高麗國王王皓遣使謝封冊。

translations.literal: Tenth month: the King of Goryeo, Wang Hao, sent envoys to thank him for the investiture.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month King Wang Hao of Goryeo sent envoys to thank the court for his investiture.

sentences.zh: 乙未，臨奠故右丞相紇石烈志寧喪，志甯妻永安縣主進鎧甲、弓矢、鷹鶻、重彩。

translations.literal: On yiwei, he attended mourning rites for the late Right Grand Councillor Heseli Zhining; Zhining’s wife, the Lady of Yong’an, presented armor, bow and arrows, falcons and hawks, and heavy silks.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei he attended the mourning rites for the late Right Grand Councillor Heseli Zhining; Zhining’s wife, Lady Yong’an, offered armor, bow and arrows, hawks and falcons, and rich silks.

sentences.zh: 壬子，召皇太子及趙王永中上殿，上顧謂宰臣曰：「京嘗圖逆，今不除之，恐為後患。

translations.literal: On renzi, he summoned the crown prince and Prince Zhao Yongzhong to the hall; turning to the chief ministers he said: “Jing once plotted rebellion; if we do not remove him now, I fear future trouble.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he summoned the crown prince and Prince Zhao Yongzhong and, facing the chief ministers, said: “Jing once plotted treason. Leave him in place and he may breed trouble later.

sentences.zh: 」又曰：「天下大器歸於有德。

translations.literal: ” Again he said: “The great vessel of the realm belongs to the virtuous.
translations.idiomatic: ” Then he said: “The realm’s great vessel goes to the man of virtue.

sentences.zh: 海陵失道，朕乃得之。

translations.literal: Hailing lost the Way—I obtained it.
translations.idiomatic: Hailing lost the Way, and I won the throne.

sentences.zh: 但務修德，余何足慮。

translations.literal: Only strive to cultivate virtue—what else is there to worry about?
translations.idiomatic: Cultivate virtue, and what is there left to fear?

sentences.zh: 」皇太子及永中皆曰：「誠如聖訓。

translations.literal: ” The crown prince and Yongzhong both said: “Truly as the sage instruction.
translations.idiomatic: ” The crown prince and Yongzhong answered: “Your teaching is just.

sentences.zh: 」遂釋之。

translations.literal: ” Thereupon Jing was released.
translations.idiomatic: ” And Jing was set free.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以德州防禦使文貲產賜其兄之子咬住，且諭其母：「文之罪，汝等皆當連坐。

translations.literal: On bingchen, with the property of Wen, defense commissioner of Dezhou, he gifted his brother’s son Yaozhu, and instructed Wen’s mother: “Wen’s crime—you all should have been implicated together.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he granted the estate of Wen, defense commissioner of Dezhou, to Wen’s brother’s son Yaozhu, and told Wen’s mother: “By Wen’s crime your whole household should have shared punishment.

sentences.zh: 念宋王有大功于國，故置不問，仍以家產賜汝子。」

translations.literal: Considering the Prince of Song’s great service to the state, therefore we set the matter aside without inquiry, and still bestowed the family property on your son.”
translations.idiomatic: Remembering the Prince of Song’s great service to the state, I held my hand and still gave the family property to your son.”

sentences.zh: 十一月甲戌，上謂宰臣曰：「宗室中有不任官事者，若不加恩澤，於親親之道，有所未弘。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiaxu, the emperor said to the chief ministers: “Among the imperial clan are those unfit for official duties; if we do not add grace, in the way of treating kin as kin something is not fully extended.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiaxu, he told the chief ministers: “Some clansmen cannot bear office. Without some favor, the bond of kinship is not fully honored.

sentences.zh: 朕欲授以散官，量予廩祿，未知前代何如？

translations.literal: I wish to grant them inactive posts and mete out salary grain in measure—how was it done in former ages?”
translations.idiomatic: I would give them nominal rank and a measured stipend—how did earlier dynasties handle this?”

sentences.zh: 」左丞石琚曰：「陶唐之親九族，周家之內睦九族，見於《詩》、《書》，皆帝王美事也。

translations.literal: ” Left Vice Councillor Shi Ju said: “Tang of Yao cherished the nine kin-groups; the house of Zhou made the nine kin-groups harmonious within—both are seen in the Odes and Documents, and both are beautiful deeds of emperors and kings.
translations.idiomatic: ” Left Vice Councillor Shi Ju said: “Yao’s affection for the nine clans and the Zhou house’s harmony among the nine clans, recorded in the Odes and Documents, are among the finest acts of sage-kings.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，上以曹國公主家奴犯事，宛平令劉彥弼杖之，主乃折辱令，既深責公主，又以台臣徇勢偷安，畏忌不敢言，奪俸一月。

translations.literal: ” On bingzi, because a household slave of the Princess of Cao had committed an offense, Wanping magistrate Liu Yanbi had him beaten with the staff; the princess then humiliated the magistrate. Having severely reproached the princess, and also because censorate officials curried power and sought ease, fearing and not daring to speak, he deducted their salaries one month.
translations.idiomatic: ” On bingzi a household slave of the Princess of Cao broke the law; Wanping magistrate Liu Yanbi had him flogged, and the princess shamed the magistrate in return. The emperor sharply rebuked the princess, then stripped one month’s salary from the censors who had curried favor, kept quiet, and dared not speak.

sentences.zh: 以陝西統軍使璋為御史大夫。

translations.literal: Shaanxi army commissioner Zhang was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Shaanxi army commissioner Zhang was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 以戶部尚書曹望之為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Cao Wangzhi was made envoy to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Cao Wangzhi was sent as Song New Year envoy.

sentences.zh: 壬午，同州民屈立等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On renwu, the people of Tong Prefecture, Qu Li and others, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Qu Li and others of Tong Prefecture plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 戊子，上屏侍臣，與宰臣議事，記注官亦退，上曰：「史官記人君善惡，朕之言動及與卿等所議，皆當與知。

translations.literal: On wuzi, the emperor dismissed attendants and discussed affairs with the chief ministers; the diarist also withdrew. The emperor said: 「Historians record a ruler’s good and evil; my words and deeds and what I discuss with you ought all to be known to them.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi the emperor sent away his attendants and conferred with the chief ministers; the diarist withdrew as well. He said: 「Historians record a ruler’s right and wrong; my words and acts and what we discuss here should all be known to them.

sentences.zh: 其於記錄無或有隱，可以朕意諭之。」

translations.literal: In recording let there be nothing concealed—you may convey my intent to them.」
translations.idiomatic: Let nothing be hidden in what is written—you may tell them as much, in my name.」

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未朔，以濟南尹劉萼在定武軍貪墨不道，命大理少卿張九思鞫之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, new moon yimao: because Jinan intendant Liu E at Dingwu Army was greedy and lawless, he ordered Assistant Director of Justice Zhang Jiusi to investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, new moon on yimao: because Jinan Intendant Liu E had been corrupt and lawless at Dingwu Army, the emperor ordered Assistant Director of Justice Zhang Jiusi to try the case.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，詔遣官及護衛二十人，分路選年二十以上四十以下有門地才行及善射者，充護衛，不得過百人。

translations.literal: On dingyou, an edict sent officials and twenty guards by separate routes to select men between twenty and forty of good lineage, talent, and skill at archery for guard service, not to exceed one hundred.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou an edict sent officials and twenty guards out by route to choose men aged twenty to forty of good family, ability, and marksmanship for the guard corps, capped at one hundred.

sentences.zh: 冀州王瓊等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Wang Qiong and others of Jizhou plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Qiong and his fellows in Jizhou plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 德州防禦使文以謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Dezhou defense commissioner Wen Yi plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Wen Yi, defense commissioner of Dezhou, plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，出宮女二十余人。

translations.literal: On xinchou, more than twenty palace women were released.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he released more than twenty palace women.

sentences.zh: 己酉，樞密副使移剌成罷。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Vice Privy Commissioner Yila Cheng was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Vice Privy Commissioner Yila Cheng left office.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，禁審錄官以宴飲廢公務。

translations.literal: On xinhai, examination-and-recording officials were forbidden to neglect public business for feasting and drinking.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai officials who examine and record cases were barred from letting feasts and drink interrupt their duties.

sentences.zh: 詔金、銀坑冶聽民開採，毋得收稅。

translations.literal: An edict allowed the people to open gold and silver mines without levying tax.
translations.idiomatic: An edict permitted commoners to work gold and silver mines without paying tax on them.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On guichou, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou he hunted in the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 以殿前都點檢徒單克寧為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Commander of the Palace Front Inspection Tuodan Kening was made vice privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Commander of Palace Front Inspection Tuodan Kening was appointed vice privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔自今除名人子孫有在仕者並取奏裁。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict ordered that from now on when appointing descendants of disgraced men who already hold office, memorial and imperial decision were required.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict ruled that from then on appointing descendants of cashiered men who were already in office required a memorial and imperial approval.

sentences.zh: 十三年正月乙丑朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Thirteenth year, first month, new moon yimao: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Year 13, first month, new moon on yimao: envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，尚書省奏，南客車俊等因榷場貿易，誤犯邊界，罪當死。

translations.literal: On guiyou, the Secretariat memorialized: the southern guest Che Jun and others, trading at the licensed market, mistakenly crossed the border; the offense was capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the Secretariat reported: the Song trader Che Jun and others, dealing at the border market, had strayed across the line by mistake and were liable to death.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「本非故意，可免罪發還，毋令彼國知之，恐複治其罪。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 「This was not intentional; they may be pardoned and sent back—do not let their country know, lest they be punished again.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 「It was no deliberate offense. Pardon them and send them home—do not let their own court know, or they may be punished again there.

sentences.zh: 」詔有司嚴禁州縣坊裏為民害者。

translations.literal: 」An edict strictly forbade in prefectures and counties and wards anything that harmed the people.
translations.idiomatic: 」An edict strictly forbade whatever in prefectures, counties, and wards harmed the people.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬子，詔太子詹事曰：「東宮官屬尤當選用正人，如行檢不修及不稱職者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on renzi, an edict to the crown prince’s director of household affairs said: 「Eastern Palace staff should especially be upright men; any of lax conduct or unfit for office—report every name.
translations.idiomatic: Intercalary month, on renzi, an edict to the crown prince’s household director said: 「Pick upright men above all for the Eastern Palace staff; report by name anyone of lax conduct or unfit for office.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，太白晝見。

translations.literal: 」On xinyou, Venus appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: 」On xinyou Venus was seen by day.

sentences.zh: 洛陽縣賊聚眾攻盧氏縣，殺縣令李庭才，亡入于宋。

translations.literal: Bandits of Luoyang County gathered a crowd, attacked Luishi County, killed Magistrate Li Tingcai, and fled into Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang County bandits mustered a force, attacked Luishi County, slew Magistrate Li Tingcai, and escaped into Song lands.

sentences.zh: 四月己巳，定出繼子所繼財產不及本家者，以所繼與本家財產通數均分制。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jisi, a regulation was fixed: when an adopted heir’s inherited property did not match the birth family’s, adoptive and birth family estates were to be pooled and divided equally.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jisi, it was decreed that when property taken by adoption fell short of the birth family’s estate, adoptive and natal holdings should be totaled and split equally.

sentences.zh: 以有司言，特授洺州孝子劉政太子掌飲丞。

translations.literal: At the offices’ recommendation, Liu Zheng the filial son of Mozhou was specially granted the post of crown prince director of libations.
translations.idiomatic: On official report Liu Zheng of Mozhou, noted for filial piety, was specially made crown prince’s director of libations.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上禦睿思殿，命歌者歌女直詞。

translations.literal: On yihai, the emperor attended at Ruisi Hall and ordered singers to sing Jurchen lyrics.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he took his seat in Ruisi Hall and had singers perform Jurchen songs.

sentences.zh: 顧謂皇太子及諸王曰：「朕思先朝所行之事，未嘗塹忘，故時聽此詞，亦欲令汝輩知之。

translations.literal: Turning to the crown prince and princes he said: 「When I think of what former reigns did I never briefly forget it; that is why I often hear these songs—I want you too to know them.
translations.idiomatic: Turning to the crown prince and the princes he said: 「I never forget for a moment what the earlier reigns did, and that is why I listen to these songs from time to time—I mean you to know them as well.

sentences.zh: 汝輩自幼惟習漢人風俗，不知女直純實之風，至於文字語言，或不通曉，是忘本也。

translations.literal: You from youth have learned only Han custom and do not know Jurchen plain honesty; as to writing and speech, some cannot understand—this is forgetting one’s roots.
translations.idiomatic: From childhood you have learned only Han ways and do not know the Jurchens’ plain, honest customs; some of you barely grasp our script and speech—that is forgetting where you came from.

sentences.zh: 汝輩當體朕意，至於子孫，亦當遵朕教誡也。

translations.literal: You should embody my intent; as for your descendants, they too should follow my teaching.
translations.idiomatic: Take my meaning to heart, and let your descendants keep to this teaching as well.

sentences.zh: 」辛巳，更定盜宗廟祭物法。

translations.literal: 」On xinsi, the law on stealing ancestral-temple sacrificial goods was revised.
translations.idiomatic: 」On xinsi the statute on theft of temple offerings was revised.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Fifth month, new moon renchen: there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth month, new moon on renchen: the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，禁女直人毋得譯為漢姓。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Jurchens were forbidden to render their names as Han surnames.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Jurchens were forbidden to adopt Han-style surnames.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，真定尹孟浩薨。

translations.literal: On renyin, Zhending intendant Meng Hao died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin Zhending Intendant Meng Hao died.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，尚書省癸，鄧州民範三毆殺人，當死，而親老無侍。

translations.literal: On jiachen, the Secretariat memorialized: Fan San of Deng Prefecture beat a man to death and deserved death, but his parents were old and without support.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Secretariat reported that Fan San of Dengzhou had beaten a man to death and merited execution, yet his parents were elderly and had no one to support them.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「在醜不爭謂之孝，孝然後能養。

translations.literal: The emperor said: 「Not quarreling in ugly situations is called filial piety; only after filial piety can one nurture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 「To bear insult without striking back is filial piety; only the filial can truly nourish their parents.

sentences.zh: 斯人以一朝之忿忘其身，而有事親之心乎？

translations.literal: Does this man, forgetting himself in a moment’s rage, have a mind to serve his parents?
translations.idiomatic: This man threw away his life in a fit of anger—did he still have a heart set on caring for his parents?

sentences.zh: 可論如法，其親，官與養濟。

translations.literal: He may be sentenced according to law; as for his kin, let the offices provide maintenance.
translations.idiomatic: Sentence him by the law; let the offices support his parents.

sentences.zh: 」六月，樞密使完顏思敬薨。

translations.literal: 」Sixth month: Privy Commissioner Wanyan Sijing died.
translations.idiomatic: 」In the sixth month Privy Commissioner Wanyan Sijing died.

sentences.zh: 七月庚子，復以會寧府為上京。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on gengzi, Huining Prefecture was again made the Upper Capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on gengzi, Huining was again named the Upper Capital.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，罷歲課雉尾。

translations.literal: On gengxu, the annual levy of pheasant tails was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the yearly tribute of pheasant tails was abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，以判大興尹趙王永中為樞密使。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingmao, Acting Daxing intendant Zhao Yongzhong was made privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingmao, Acting Daxing Intendant Zhao Yongzhong was appointed privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 詔賜諸猛安謀克廉能三等官賞。

translations.literal: An edict rewarded all meng'an and mouke of three grades—incorrupt, able—with office and gifts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted office rewards to every meng'an and mouke placed in the top three grades for integrity and ability.

sentences.zh: 己卯，御史大夫璋罷。

translations.literal: On jimao, Censor-in-Chief Zhang was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Censor-in-Chief Zhang left office.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以左副都點檢襄等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Left Deputy Palace Inspector Xiang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Left Deputy Palace Inspector Xiang and others were sent as Song birthday envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，秋獵。

translations.literal: On dinghai, autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯朔，以宿直將軍胡什賚為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, new moon xinmao: Night-Duty General Hushen was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth month, new moon on xinmao: Night-Duty General Hushen was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，還都。

translations.literal: On xinhai, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 大名府僧李智究等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: The monk Li Zhijiu and others of Daming Prefecture plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zhijiu the monk of Daming and his fellows plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 十月乙丑，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yichou, Jupiter appeared in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yichou, Jupiter was visible by day.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以前南京留守唐括安禮為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On bingzi, former Nanjing regent Tangguo Anli was made right vice director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi former Nanjing regent Tangguo Anli was appointed right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十一月，以大興尹璋為賀宋正旦使，引進使大洞為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, Daxing Prefect Zhang was made envoy to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day; Commissioner of Introduction Dadong was made envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Zhang, prefect of Daxing, was appointed envoy to congratulate Song on the new year; Dadong, commissioner of introduction, was sent as envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「外路正五品職事多闕員，何也？

translations.literal: The emperor said to the chief ministers: "Many fifth-rank posts on the outer circuits stand vacant—why?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers: "Fifth-rank offices on the outer circuits are often unfilled—why is that?"

sentences.zh: 」太尉李石對曰：「資考少有及者。

translations.literal: " Grand Marshal Li Shi answered: "Few pass the qualification review.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Marshal Li Shi replied: "Few candidates meet the seniority and merit requirements."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「苟有賢能，當不次用之。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "If there is talent, he should be promoted out of turn.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "Where there is ability, promote him without waiting his turn."

sentences.zh: 」壬子，吏部尚書梁肅請禁奴婢服羅綺。

translations.literal: " On renzi, Minister of Personnel Liang Su requested forbidding servants from wearing silks and brocades.
translations.idiomatic: " On renzi Minister of Personnel Liang Su asked that slaves and servants be barred from wearing silk and brocade.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「近已禁其服明金。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Recently we have already forbidden them to wear bright gold.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "We have only lately forbidden them bright gold trim.

sentences.zh: 行之以漸可也。

translations.literal: To carry this out gradually would be acceptable.
translations.idiomatic: Let the rule take effect step by step—that will do.

sentences.zh: 且教化之行，當自貴近始。

translations.literal: Moreover, when instruction in custom goes forward, it should begin with the noble and those close at hand.
translations.idiomatic: Reform of custom must start with the court and those nearest the throne.

sentences.zh: 朕宮中服禦，常自節約，舊服明金者，已減太半矣！

translations.literal: In the palace I constantly economize in dress; those who once wore bright gold have already been reduced by more than half!
translations.idiomatic: I myself dress plainly in the palace; courtiers who used bright gold have already been cut by more than half.

sentences.zh: 近民間風俗，比正隆時聞稍淳儉，卿等當更務從儉素，使民知所效也。」

translations.literal: Of late among the people custom is said to be somewhat purer and thriftier than in the Zhenglong era—you should strive all the more for frugality, so the people know what to imitate."
translations.idiomatic: Folkways today are said to be a little simpler than under Zhenglong. You must be thriftier still, so the people have a model to follow."

sentences.zh: 十四年正月已醜朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: First month of year fourteen, on jichou the new moon; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year fourteen, on jichou at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 二月壬戌，以大興尹璋使宋有罪，杖百五十，除名，仍以所受禮物入官。

translations.literal: Second month, on renxu, because Daxing Prefect Zhang was guilty on his mission to Song, he received one hundred fifty blows and was struck from the rolls; the gifts he had received were also confiscated to the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on renxu, Zhang of Daxing—guilty on his Song mission—was flogged one hundred fifty times, dismissed, and the presents he had taken were forfeited to the state.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以刑部尚書梁肅等為宋詳問使。

translations.literal: On bingyin, Minister of Justice Liang Su and others were made Song enquiry envoys.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Liang Su, minister of justice, and others were sent as envoys to press Song for an account.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以太尉、尚書令李石為太保，致仕。

translations.literal: On gengwu, Grand Marshal and Director of the Secretariat Li Shi was made Grand Guardian and retired.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Grand Marshal and Secretariat Director Li Shi was named grand guardian and retired from office.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，詔免去年被水旱百姓租稅。

translations.literal: On wuyin, an edict remitted last year’s rent and tax for people stricken by flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin an edict waived last year’s land tax for communities hit by flood or drought.

sentences.zh: 三月戊子朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on wuzi the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on wuzi at the new moon—the Wan Spring festival—Song, Goryeo, and Xia again sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 甲午，上謂大臣曰：「海陵純尚吏事，當時宰執止以案牘為功。

translations.literal: On jiawu the emperor told the great ministers: "Hailing prized bureaucratic routine alone; then the chief ministers took paperwork as their only accomplishment.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he told the great ministers: "Hailing cared only for paperwork; his chief ministers measured themselves by the docket alone.

sentences.zh: 卿等當思經濟之術，不可狃于故常也。

translations.literal: You should think of ways to sustain the state—do not cling to old habit."
translations.idiomatic: You must think how to nourish the realm—do not stay trapped in the old ways."

sentences.zh: 」又詔：「猛安謀克之民，今後不許殺生祈祭。

translations.literal: An edict also said: "Among the meng’an and mouke, henceforth killing animals for prayer and sacrifice is not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Meng’an and mouke households may no longer slaughter livestock for prayer-offerings.

sentences.zh: 若遇節辰及祭天日，許得飲會。

translations.literal: When festivals and heaven-worship days occur, drinking gatherings are allowed.
translations.idiomatic: On feast days and days of heaven-worship they may hold drinking gatherings.

sentences.zh: 自二月一日至八月終，並禁絕飲燕，亦不許赴會他所，恐妨農功。

translations.literal: From the first of the second month through the end of the eighth, banquets and drinking are forbidden; going to gatherings elsewhere is also forbidden, lest farm work suffer.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of the second month through the end of the eighth month all feasts and drinking are banned, and they may not attend gatherings elsewhere, lest the harvest suffer.

sentences.zh: 雖閑月亦不許痛飲，犯者抵罪。

translations.literal: Even in slack months hard drinking is not allowed; offenders will be punished.
translations.idiomatic: Even in the slack season heavy drinking is forbidden; violators will be punished.

sentences.zh: 可遍諭之。

translations.literal: Proclaim this throughout.
translations.idiomatic: Make this known everywhere."

sentences.zh: 」又命：「應衛士有不閑女直語者，並勒習學，仍自後不得漢語。

translations.literal: An order also said: "Guards who are not fluent in Jurchen must be compelled to study; from now on they may not speak Chinese."
translations.idiomatic: He also ordered: "Guards who do not know Jurchen must be drilled in it, and henceforth may not use Chinese in service."

sentences.zh: 」辛丑，太白、歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On xinchou Venus and Jupiter were seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Venus and Jupiter appeared in broad daylight.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，上更名雍，詔中外。

translations.literal: On jiachen the emperor changed his name to Yong and proclaimed it within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the emperor took the taboo name Yong and announced it through the realm.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，太白、歲星晝見，經天。

translations.literal: On bingchen Venus and Jupiter were seen in daytime and crossed the sky.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Venus and Jupiter shone by day and crossed the heavens.

sentences.zh: 四月乙丑，上諭宰臣曰：「聞愚民祈福，多建佛寺，雖已條禁，尚多犯者，宜申約束，無令徒費財用。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on yichou, the emperor instructed the chief ministers: "I hear that foolish people seeking blessing build many Buddhist temples; though regulations forbid it, many still offend—tighten the restraints and do not let wealth be wasted in vain."
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on yichou, he told the chief ministers: "Common people seeking merit keep raising temples; though the law forbids it, many still build—tighten enforcement and stop them from throwing away their substance."

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，有事於太廟，以皇太子攝行事。

translations.literal: On wuchen rites were performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, with the crown prince acting in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen rites were held at the Imperial Ancestral Temple, the crown prince presiding in his place.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以勸農副使完顏蒲涅為橫賜高麗使。

translations.literal: On yihai Agriculture Vice Commissioner Wanyan Punie was made envoy to grant Goryeo imperial gifts.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Wanyan Punie, vice commissioner for encouraging agriculture, was sent to convey imperial gifts to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 上禦垂拱殿，顧謂皇太子及親王曰：「人之行，莫大于孝弟，孝弟無不蒙天日之佑。

translations.literal: At the Chui Gong Hall the emperor addressed the crown prince and princes: "In human conduct nothing is greater than filial piety and fraternal duty; those who practice them invariably receive Heaven’s protection.
translations.idiomatic: At the Chui Gong Hall he turned to the crown prince and the princes: "In a man’s life nothing outweighs filial piety and brotherly love; those who keep them always enjoy Heaven’s favor.

sentences.zh: 汝等宜盡孝于父母，友于兄弟。

translations.literal: You should be fully filial to your parents and friendly to your brothers.
translations.idiomatic: Be wholly filial to your parents and cordial with your brothers.

sentences.zh: 自古兄弟之際，多因妻妾離間，以至相違。

translations.literal: Since antiquity among brothers, wives and concubines often caused estrangement through sowing discord.
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity brothers have often been pulled apart when wives and concubines came between them.

sentences.zh: 且妻者乃外屬耳，可比兄弟之親乎？

translations.literal: Moreover, a wife is an outsider by kinship—how can she compare to the closeness of brothers?
translations.idiomatic: A wife is kin by marriage only—how can she rank with a brother’s bond?

sentences.zh: 若妻言是聽，而兄弟相違 ，甚非理也。

translations.literal: If you obey whatever your wife says and turn from your brothers, that is greatly against reason.
translations.idiomatic: To heed your wife and break with your brothers is wholly against right.

sentences.zh: 汝等當以朕言常銘於心。

translations.literal: You should keep my words always engraved in your hearts."
translations.idiomatic: Keep what I say carved in your hearts."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以樞密副使徒單克甯兼大興尹。

translations.literal: On wuzi Deputy Commissioner of Military Affairs Tudan Kening was made concurrent Daxing Prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Tudan Kening, deputy commissioner of military affairs, was also named prefect of Daxing.

sentences.zh: 五月丙戌朔，詳問使梁肅等還自宋。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingxu the new moon, enquiry envoys Liang Su and others returned from Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingxu at the new moon, Liang Su and the other enquiry envoys returned from Song.

sentences.zh: 甲午，如金蓮川。

translations.literal: On jiawu he proceeded to Jinlian River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu he went to Jinlian River.

sentences.zh: 六月乙未，太白晝見。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yiwei Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yiwei, Venus appeared by day.

sentences.zh: 八月丁已，次糺裏舌。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on dingsi, he halted at Jiuli She.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on dingsi, he encamped at Jiuli She.

sentences.zh: 日中，白龍見禦帳東小港中，須臾，乘雲雷而去。

translations.literal: At noon a white dragon appeared in a small stream east of the imperial tent; in a moment it rode off on clouds and thunder.
translations.idiomatic: At noon a white dragon was seen in a brook east of the imperial tent; in an instant it rose away on cloud and thunder.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，獵於彌離補。

translations.literal: On guihai he hunted at Mili Bu.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai he hunted at Mili Bu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jimao Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，還都。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dinghai, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dinghai, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙未，以兵部尚書完顏讓等為賀宋生日使，宿直將軍崇肅為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On yiwei Minister of War Wanyan Rang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; Palace Duty General Chong Su was envoy for the Xia emperor’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Wanyan Rang, minister of war, and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; Palace duty general Chong Su was envoy for the Xia ruler’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，上退朝，謂侍臣曰：「朕自在潛邸及踐阼以至於今，于親屬舊知未嘗欺心有徇。

translations.literal: On guimao, after court the emperor told his attendants: "From my time in the secluded residence through my accession until now, toward kin and old acquaintances I have never knowingly favored anyone unjustly.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, after audience, he told his attendants: "From my years in the princely residence through my reign until today I have never knowingly shown partiality to kin or old friends.

sentences.zh: 近御史台奏，樞密使永中嘗致書河南統軍使完顏仲，托以賣為。

translations.literal: Recently the Censorate reported that Military Affairs Commissioner Yongzhong once wrote to Henan army commander Wanyan Zhong, asking him to sell offices on his behalf.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the Censorate reported that Military Affairs Commissioner Yongzhong had written to Henan commander Wanyan Zhong to sell offices for him.

sentences.zh: 朕知而不問。

translations.literal: I knew but did not pursue it.
translations.idiomatic: I knew of it and did not inquire.

sentences.zh: 朕之欺心，此一事耳，夙夜思之，其如有疾。

translations.literal: The one matter in which I have deceived my conscience is this alone; I think of it day and night as though I were ill.
translations.idiomatic: This is the one thing in which I have wronged my own heart; I brood on it day and night as on a sickness.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，宋遣使報聘。

translations.literal: " On jiyou Song sent envoys on a return courtesy mission.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou Song sent envoys on a return visit of courtesy.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯朔，詔圖畫功臣二十人衍慶宮聖武殿之左右廡。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yimao the new moon, an edict ordered portraits painted of twenty meritorious ministers in the side galleries of the Shenwu Hall at Yanguang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yimao at the new moon, the court ordered portraits of twenty meritorious ministers painted in the side galleries of the Shenwu Hall at Yanguang Palace.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiashen at the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 丙申，御史中丞劉仲誨等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On bingshen Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，召尚食局使，諭之曰；

translations.literal: On wuxu the Director of the Imperial Kitchen was summoned and instructed, saying:
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu the director of the imperial kitchen was called in and told:

sentences.zh: 「太官之食，皆民脂膏。

translations.literal: " Food from the Grand Kitchen is all the people’s fat and grease.
translations.idiomatic: " The Grand Kitchen’s fare is drawn from the people’s sweat and blood.

sentences.zh: 日者品味太多，不可遍舉，徒為虛費。

translations.literal: Of late the varieties of dishes have been too many to serve in full—it is only empty waste.
translations.idiomatic: Lately the menu has grown so long that not every dish can be served, and much is simply wasted.

sentences.zh: 自今止進可口者數品而已。

translations.literal: From now on present only a few palatable kinds."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter offer only a few dishes that are truly good to eat."

sentences.zh: 」戊申，以儀鸞局使曹士元為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: " On wushen Ceremonial Escort Bureau commissioner Cao Shiyuan was made envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: " On wushen Cao Shiyuan of the Ceremonial Escort Bureau was sent as envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅，以平章政事完顏守道為右丞相，樞密副使徒單克甯為平章政事。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuyin, Associate Administration Councillor Wanyan Shoudao was made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat; Vice Privy Commissioner Tudan Kening was made Associate Administration Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuyin, Associate Administration Councillor Wanyan Shoudao became right chancellor of the Secretariat, and Vice Privy Commissioner Tudan Kening associate administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 十五年正月。

translations.literal: First month of year fifteen.
translations.idiomatic: Year fifteen, first month.

sentences.zh: 此下闕。

translations.literal: Below this the text is missing.
translations.idiomatic: The record below is lost.

sentences.zh: 七月丙午，粘拔恩與所部康裏孛古等內附。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingwu, Zhanba’en and the Kangli tribesmen Bogu under his command submitted to the court.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingwu, Zhanba’en and the Kangli chief Bogu with his following came in to allegiance.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuzi, he returned from Jinlian River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuzi, he returned from Jinlian River.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，高麗西京留守趙位寵叛其君，請以慈悲嶺以西，鴨淥江以東四十於城內附，不納。

translations.literal: On xinmao Zhao Weichong, Western Capital military commissioner of Goryeo, rebelled against his ruler and asked to submit west of Cizhi Ridge and east of the Yalu with forty-odd walled towns; the request was refused.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Zhao Weichong, Goryeo’s Western Capital commissioner, rebelled against his king and offered to submit the forty-odd walled towns west of Cizhi Ridge and east of the Yalu; the court declined.

sentences.zh: 丙申，幸新宮。

translations.literal: On bingchen he visited the new palace.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen he went to the new palace.

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉朔，定應禁弓箭槍刀路分品官家奴客旅等許帶弓箭制。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on jiyou the new moon, regulations were fixed on who among officials, household slaves, travelers, and others on restricted routes might carry bows, arrows, spears, and blades.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on jiyou at the new moon, the court set rules on which officials, retainers, travelers, and others on controlled routes might carry bows, arrows, spears, and blades.

sentences.zh: 上謂左丞相良弼曰：「今之在官者，須職位稱愜所望，然後始加勉力。

translations.literal: The emperor said to Left Chancellor Heishilie Liangbi: "Officials today must find their posts fully to their liking before they will exert themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told Left Chancellor Heishilie Liangbi: "Men in office today will only work hard when rank and duty suit their wishes exactly.

sentences.zh: 其或稍不如意，則止以度日為務，是豈忠臣之道耶？

translations.literal: If things are even slightly not to their mind, they merely pass the days—is that the way of loyal ministers?"
translations.idiomatic: If anything falls short of their hopes, they do no more than mark time—can that be loyal service?"

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，又謂良弼曰：「海陵時，領省秉德、左丞相言皆有能名，然為政不務遠圖，止以苛刻為事。

translations.literal: " On dingsi he again told Liangbi: "Under Hailing, Northern Commission Chief Bingde and Left Chief Councillor Yan both had reputations for ability, yet in government they sought no far-reaching plan and dealt only in harshness.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingsi he again told Liangbi: "In Hailing’s day Chief Bingde of the Northern Commission and Left Chief Councillor Yan were both thought able, yet they governed without long view and made cruelty their policy.

sentences.zh: 言及可喜等在會甯時，一月之間，杖而殺之者二十人，罪皆不至於死，於理可乎？

translations.literal: Speaking of Kexi and the like—when at Huining, within one month they beat and killed twenty men, crimes none of which deserved death; was that reasonable?"
translations.idiomatic: Take Kexi and his sort: at Huining, within a single month they flogged twenty men to death for offenses that did not warrant it—was that just?"

sentences.zh: 海陵為人如虎，此輩尚欲以術數要之，以至賣直取死，得為能乎？

translations.literal: Hailing was fierce as a tiger, yet these men still tried to win him with divination, even selling their integrity and courting death—can that be called ability?"
translations.idiomatic: Hailing was savage as a tiger, yet they still tried to sway him with fortune-telling, peddling their honor until they died for it—does that deserve to be called talent?"

sentences.zh: 」己未，以歸德尹完顏王祥等為賀宋生日使，符寶郎斜卯和尚為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: " On jiwei Guiding intendant Wanyan Wangxiang and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; tally-and-seal officer Xiemao Heshang was envoy for the Xia ruler’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiwei Wanyan Wangxiang, intendant of Guiding, and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; tally-and-seal officer Xiemao Heshang was envoy for the Xia ruler’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，高麗國王奏告趙位寵伏誅，詔慰答之。

translations.literal: On xinyou the king of Goryeo memorialized that Zhao Weichong had been executed; an edict answered him with consolation.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the king of Goryeo reported that Zhao Weichong had been put to death; the court replied with words of comfort.

sentences.zh: 詔親王、百官傔人所服紅紫改為黑紫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that the red and purple worn by princes’ and officials’ personal attendants be changed to black and purple.
translations.idiomatic: An edict changed the red and purple dress of princes’ and officials’ attendants to black and purple.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔年老之人毋注縣令。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict forbade appointing the aged as county magistrates.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict barred appointing elderly men as county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 年老而任從政，其佐亦擇壯者參用。

translations.literal: When the aged still held office, their assistants were also to be chosen from men in their prime and used together.
translations.idiomatic: Where an older man still served, a vigorous assistant was to be paired with him in the same post.

sentences.zh: 十月乙卯，冬獵。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on yimao, winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on yimao, the winter hunt began.

sentences.zh: 丁未，還都。

translations.literal: On dingwei he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月乙卯，上幸東宮。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on yimao, the emperor visited the Eastern Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on yimao, the emperor went to the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 初，唐古部族節度使移剌毛得之子殺其妻而逃，上命捕之。

translations.literal: Earlier, the son of Tanggu tribal military commissioner Yila Maode had killed his wife and fled; the emperor ordered him seized.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the son of Tanggu military commissioner Yila Maode had murdered his wife and fled; the emperor ordered him captured.

sentences.zh: 至是，皇姑梁國公主請赦之。

translations.literal: At this time the emperor’s paternal aunt, Princess of Liang, asked that he be pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: Now the emperor’s paternal aunt, the Princess of Liang, begged a pardon for him.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「公主婦人，不識典法，罪尚可恕。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "The princess is a woman and does not understand statute; her fault may be forgiven.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers: "The princess is a woman and does not know the law; her mistake may be overlooked.

sentences.zh: 毛得請托至此，豈可貸宥？

translations.literal: That Maode should plead so far—how can he be spared?"
translations.idiomatic: But for Maode to lobby to this point—how can he be let off?"

sentences.zh: 」不許。

translations.literal: He did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以右宣征使靖等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On wuwu Right Campaign Commissioner Jing and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Right Campaign Commissioner Jing and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 甲子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiazi Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以宿直將軍阿典蒲魯虎為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On wuchen Palace Duty General Adian Puluhu was made envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Palace duty general Adian Puluhu was sent as envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 十六年正月戊申朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: First month of year sixteen, on wushen the new moon; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year sixteen, on wushen at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，詔免去年被水、旱路分租稅。

translations.literal: On jiayin an edict remitted last year’s rent and tax for circuits stricken by flood and drought.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin an edict waived last year’s land tax in circuits hit by flood or drought.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔宗屬未附玉牒者並與編次。

translations.literal: On jiazi an edict ordered that clansmen not yet entered in the jade genealogical register were all to be compiled and recorded.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi an edict directed that imperial clansmen not yet on the jade genealogy were to be registered and compiled.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，上與親王、宰執、從官從容論古今興廢事，曰：「經籍之興，其來久矣，垂教後世，無不盡善。

translations.literal: On bingyin the emperor, at ease with princes, chief ministers, and attendants, discussed the rise and fall of states through the ages, saying: "The rise of the classics is of long standing; in instructing later ages nothing is not wholly good.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, speaking at leisure with princes, chief ministers, and attendants about how realms rise and fall, he said: "The classics have been with us a long time; nothing they teach posterity is without value.

sentences.zh: 今之學者，既能誦之，必須行之。

translations.literal: Scholars today, if they can recite them, must also put them into practice.
translations.idiomatic: Students who can recite them must also live by them.

sentences.zh: 然知而不能行者多矣，苟不能行，誦之何益？

translations.literal: Yet many know and do not act—if they will not act, what good is recitation?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet many know the words and do not practice them—if they will not practice, what use is chanting?"

sentences.zh: 女直舊風最為純直，雖不知書，然其祭天地，敬親戚，尊耆老，接賓客，信朋友，禮意款曲，皆出自然，其善與古書所載無異。

translations.literal: The old Jurchen ways are most plain and upright: though they did not know books, in sacrificing to Heaven and Earth, honoring kin, respecting the aged, receiving guests, and keeping faith with friends, their courtesy was warm and sincere—all from nature, and their goodness no different from what the ancient books record.
translations.idiomatic: Jurchen custom at its purest is utterly straightforward: without knowing books, they worshipped Heaven and Earth, honored kin, respected the aged, received guests, and kept faith with friends in ways warm and sincere, all from the heart—and their virtues match what the classics praise.

sentences.zh: 汝輩當習學之，舊風不可忘也！

translations.literal: You should study these things—the old ways must not be forgotten!"
translations.idiomatic: You must learn from that—the old ways must not be forgotten!"

sentences.zh: 」戊辰，宮中火。

translations.literal: " On wuchen fire broke out in the palace.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuchen fire broke out in the palace.

sentences.zh: 庚午，上按鷹高橋，見道側醉人墮驢而臥，命左右扶而乘之，送至其家。

translations.literal: On gengwu, while hawking at Gao Bridge, he saw a drunk by the road fall from his donkey and lie there; he ordered attendants to help him up, set him on the beast, and send him home.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, hawking at Gao Bridge, he saw a drunk fall from his donkey by the road; he had attendants lift him, set him back on the animal, and escort him home.

sentences.zh: 辛未，皇姑邀上至私第，諸妃皆從，宴飲甚歡。

translations.literal: On xinwei the emperor’s paternal aunt invited him to her private residence; all the consorts followed, and the feast was very merry.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei his paternal aunt, the princess, invited him to her private house; the consorts all came, and the drinking was joyful.

sentences.zh: 公主每進酒，上立飲之。

translations.literal: Whenever the princess offered wine, the emperor stood and drank it.
translations.idiomatic: Each time the princess poured wine, the emperor rose and drained the cup.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，皇子豳王妃徒單氏以奸，伏誅。

translations.literal: Second month, on gengyin, the prince of Bin’s consort of the Tudan clan was executed for adultery.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, the prince of Bin’s consort, née Tudan, was put to death for adultery.

sentences.zh: 己亥，平章政事單克寧罷，以女故。

translations.literal: On jihai, Participation Councillor Shan Kening was dismissed on account of his daughter.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Participation Councillor Shan Kening left office because of his daughter.

sentences.zh: 三月丙午朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Third month, on bingwu, the new moon: there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on bingwu at the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 是日，萬春節，改用明日，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: That day was the Ten Thousand Spring Festival; it was moved to the following day. Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: That day was the Ten Thousand Spring Festival, so the celebration was shifted to the next day; envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 戊申，雨豆於臨潢之境。

translations.literal: On wushen beans rained in the territory of Linhuang.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen a rain of beans fell in the Linhuang region.

sentences.zh: 戊午，上禦廣仁殿，皇太子、親王皆侍膳，上從容訓之曰：「大凡資用當務節省，如其有餘，可周親戚，勿妄費也。

translations.literal: On wuwu the emperor took his meal in the Guangren Hall; the crown prince and the princes all attended. At ease he instructed them, saying: 「In general one’s expenses should be kept economical; if there is surplus, it may be shared with kin—do not squander it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu he dined in the Guangren Hall with the crown prince and the princes in attendance. Speaking calmly he told them: 「You should always live within your means; whatever is left over may go to relatives—do not waste it.

sentences.zh: 」因舉所禦服曰：「此服已三年未嘗更換，尚爾完好，汝等宜識之。

translations.literal: 」He then held up the robe he was wearing and said: 「This garment has gone three years without being replaced, yet it is still sound—you should take note of that.
translations.idiomatic: 」Then he lifted the robe he wore and said: 「I have worn this three years without changing it, and it is still whole—remember that.

sentences.zh: 」壬申，複置吾都碗部禿裏。

translations.literal: 」On renshen the tuli office of the Wudawan tribe was restored.
translations.idiomatic: 」On renshen the Wudawan tribal tuli post was re-established.

sentences.zh: 四月丙戌，詔京府設學養土，及定宗室、宰相子程試等第。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on bingxu, an edict ordered the capital prefectures to establish schools to nurture scholars and to fix graded examination ranks for sons of the imperial clan and of chief ministers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on bingxu an edict directed the metropolitan prefectures to open schools for scholars and to set graded examination standards for sons of the imperial house and of chief ministers.

sentences.zh: 戊子，制商賈舟車不得用馬。

translations.literal: On wuzi a statute forbade merchants’ carts and boats to use horses.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi merchants were barred from using horses on carts and boats.

sentences.zh: 以東京留守崇尹為樞密副使。

translations.literal: Eastern Capital chief Chong Yin was made vice privy commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Chong Yin, chief of the Eastern Capital, was appointed vice privy commissioner.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，如金蓮川。

translations.literal: On renyin he went to Jinlian River.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin he went to Jinlian River.

sentences.zh: 五月戊申，南京宮殿火。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wushen, fire broke out in the Nanjing palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wushen, fire destroyed part of the Nanjing palace.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jiayin Venus was visible by day.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚申，遣使禱雨靜寧山神，有頃而雨。

translations.literal: On gengshen envoys were sent to pray for rain to the god of Jingning Mountain; before long it rained.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the court sent envoys to pray for rain at Jingning Mountain; rain fell shortly after.

sentences.zh: 六月，山東兩路蝗。

translations.literal: Sixth month: the two Shandong circuits suffered locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month locusts struck the two Shandong circuits.

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，夏津縣令移剌山往坐贓，伏誅。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on renzi, Xiajin County magistrate Yila Shanwang was executed for corruption.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renzi, Yila Shanwang, magistrate of Xiajin County, was put to death for graft.

sentences.zh: 八月辛巳，次霹靂濼。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on xinsi, he halted at Pilei Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on xinsi, he stopped at Pilei Marsh.

sentences.zh: 九月乙巳，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on yisi, he returned from Jinlian River.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on yisi, he returned from Jinlian River.

sentences.zh: 己酉，諭左丞相紇石烈良弼曰：「西邊自來不備儲蓄，其令所在和糴，以為緩急之備。

translations.literal: On jiyou he told Left Chief Councillor Heishilie Liangbi: 「The western circuits have never kept grain in reserve; order the localities to buy grain on government account as a standby for emergencies.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou he told Left Chief Councillor Heishilie Liangbi: 「The west has never stored grain; have each circuit buy grain on government account against sudden need.

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，以殿前都點檢蒲察通等為賀宋生日使，宿直將軍完顏覿古速為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: 」On guichou Palace Front Inspection commander Puchatong and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; duty-night general Wanyan Digusu was made envoy for Xia’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: 」On guichou Puchatong, commander of the Palace Front Inspection, and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday, and duty-night general Wanyan Digusu was sent for Xia’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 諭左丞相良弼曰：「海陵非理殺戮臣下，甚可哀憫。

translations.literal: He told Left Chief Councillor Liangbi: 「Hailing slaughtered his ministers without justice—it is deeply pitiable.
translations.idiomatic: He again told Liangbi: 「Hailing killed ministers without cause; the matter is grievous.

sentences.zh: 其孛論出等遺骸，仰逐處訪求，官為收葬。

translations.literal: As for Bolunchu and the others, their remains—have each place search them out and let the state bury them.
translations.idiomatic: For Bolunchu and the rest, search out their remains wherever they may be and have the state give them burial.

sentences.zh: 」辛酉，以南京宮殿火，留守、轉運兩司皆抵罪。

translations.literal: 」On xinyou, because of the Nanjing palace fire, the Southern Capital chief and the transport commissioners were all punished.
translations.idiomatic: 」On xinyou, after the Nanjing palace fire, the Southern Capital chief and the transport commissioners were all held to account.

sentences.zh: 十月丙申，詔諭宰執曰：「諸王小字未嘗以女直語命之，今皆當更易，卿等擇名以上。」

translations.literal: Tenth month, on bingchen, an edict told the chief ministers: 「The princes’ childhood names have never been given in Jurchen; all should now be changed—you are to choose names and submit them.」
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on bingchen, an edict said to the chief ministers: 「The princes’ pet names were never set in Jurchen; change them all now and present your choices.」

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅朔，參知政事王蔚罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renyin, the new moon: Participation Councillor Wang Yu was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renyin at the new moon, Participation Councillor Wang Yu left office.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏，河北東路胡剌溫猛安所轄謀克孛朮魯舍廝，參謀克讓其兄子蒲速列。

translations.literal: The Department of State Affairs memorialized that in the Halawen meng’an under the Eastern Hebei Route, para-meng’an Beipailu Shessi of the murianke yielded his place to his elder brother’s son Pusulie.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported that in the Halawen meng’an on the Eastern Hebei Route, para-meng’an Beipailu Shessi of the murianke had yielded his post to his elder brother’s son Pusulie.

sentences.zh: 上賢而從之，仍令議加舍廝恩賞。

translations.literal: The emperor approved him as worthy and assented, and also ordered discussion of added favor for Shessi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor praised his conduct and agreed, and ordered deliberation on further rewards for Shessi.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以同知宣徽院事劉珫等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On wuwu, Associate Director of the Palace Domestic Service Liu Qiu and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Liu Qiu, associate director of the Palace Domestic Service, and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以吏部尚書張汝弼為參知政事。

translations.literal: On gengshen, Minister of Personnel Zhang Rubi was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Zhang Rubi, minister of personnel, became participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 甲子，以粘割韓奴之子詳古為尚輦局直長，婁室為武器直長。

translations.literal: On jiazi, Niancha Hannu’s son Xianggu was made chief of the Imperial Equipage Bureau, and Loushi chief of the Weapons Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Hannu’s son Xianggu was made chief of the Imperial Equipage Bureau and Loushi chief of the Weapons Bureau.

sentences.zh: 初，韓奴被旨招契丹大石，後不知所終，至是因粘拔恩部長撒裏雅寅特斯等來，詢知其死節之詳，故錄其後。

translations.literal: Earlier Hannu had been ordered to summon the Khitan Dashi; afterward his fate was unknown. Now, because the Nianba’en tribal chief Saliya Yintesi and others came in, the full story of his death in loyalty was learned, and so his descendants were recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Hannu had once been sent to win over the Khitan Dashi and was never heard from again; when Nianba’en chief Saliya Yintesi arrived, the court learned how he died loyal to his charge and enrolled his sons.

sentences.zh: 遣兵部郎中移剌子元為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Yila Ziyuan of the Ministry of War was sent as envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Yila Ziyuan of the Ministry of War was dispatched as Goryeo birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 十二月壬申朔，詔諸科人出身四十年方注縣令，年歲太遠，今後仕及三十二年，別無負犯贓染追奪，便與縣令。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on renshen, the new moon: an edict said that men who entered office through the various examinations had to wait forty years before appointment as county magistrate—the interval was too long; hereafter, after thirty-two years in service, if there were no guilt, corruption, or forfeiture, they might receive a county magistracy.
translations.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on renshen at the new moon: an edict ruled that graduates of the special examinations who waited forty years for a county post waited too long; after thirty-two years of service, if they had no crime, graft, or stripped rank, they might be made county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 丙子，詔諸流移人老病者，官與養濟。

translations.literal: On bingzi an edict ordered that exiles who were aged or ill should be supported by the state.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi an edict directed the state to support exiled convicts who were old or sick.

sentences.zh: 上諭宰臣曰：「凡已經奏斷事有未當，卿等勿謂已行，不為奏聞改正。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: 「Whenever a matter already decided by memorial proves wrong, do not suppose that because it has been carried out you need not report it for correction.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers: 「If a case we have already ruled on was wrong, do not hold back because the order has gone out—tell me so it can be set right.

sentences.zh: 朕以萬幾之繁，豈無一失？

translations.literal: With the myriad affairs upon me, can there fail to be a slip?
translations.idiomatic: With all these duties on me, am I incapable of a mistake?

sentences.zh: 卿等但言之，朕當更改，必無吝也！

translations.literal: You have only to speak—I shall change course and will not be grudging!」
translations.idiomatic: Speak up—I will amend my course and will not be stingy!」

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，定榷場香茶罪賞法。

translations.literal: 」On gengyin the law on offenses and rewards for tea and incense at the frontier markets was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: 」On gengyin the penalties and rewards for tea and incense smuggling at the frontier markets were codified.

sentences.zh: 十七年正月壬寅朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year seventeen, first month, on renyin, the new moon: Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to congratulate.
translations.idiomatic: Year 17, first month, on renyin at the new moon, envoys from Song, Goryeo, and Xia came with congratulations.

sentences.zh: 高麗並表謝不納趙位寵。

translations.literal: Goryeo also memorialized thanks for not accepting Zhao Weichong.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo also sent a memorial thanking the court for refusing Zhao Weichong.

sentences.zh: 丙午，有司奏，高麗所進玉帶乃石似玉者，上曰：「小國無能辨識者，誤以為玉耳！

translations.literal: On bingwu the responsible offices memorialized that the jade belt Goryeo had presented was stone resembling jade. The emperor said: 「A small state has no one able to tell them apart—they mistook it for jade!
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu the ministries reported that Goryeo’s “jade” belt was stone that looked like jade. The emperor said: 「A small country lacks men who can tell—their mistake is understandable!

sentences.zh: 且人不易物，惟德其物，若複卻之，豈禮體耶？

translations.literal: Moreover, men do not lightly change what they hold; only virtue dignifies a thing. If we sent it back, would that not violate ritual propriety?」
translations.idiomatic: Gifts are not lightly returned; only the giver’s good faith gives them worth. To reject it now—would that not break courtesy?」

sentences.zh: 」戊申，詔于衍慶宮聖武殿西建世祖神禦殿，東建太宗、睿宗神禦殿。

translations.literal: 」On wushen an edict ordered west of the Shengwu Hall at Yanging Palace a spirit-image hall for Taizu built, and east of it spirit-image halls for Taizong and Ruizong.
translations.idiomatic: 」On wushen an edict directed that west of the Shengwu Hall at Yanging Palace a spirit hall for Taizu be built, and to its east spirit halls for Taizong and Ruizong.

sentences.zh: 詔西北路招討司契丹民戶，其嘗叛亂者已行措置，其不與叛亂及放良奴隸可徙烏古裏石壘部，令及春耕作。

translations.literal: An edict to the Northwestern Route Recruitment Commission concerning Khitan households: those who had rebelled had already been dealt with; those who had not joined the rebellion and freed slaves might be moved to the Wuguri Shilei department and put to spring plowing.
translations.idiomatic: An edict to the Northwestern Route Recruitment Commission on Khitan households ruled that rebels had already been handled; non-rebels and manumitted slaves might be resettled in the Wuguri Shilei department for spring planting.

sentences.zh: 尚書省奏，吾都碗部體土胡魯雅裏密斯請入獻，許之。

translations.literal: The Department of State Affairs memorialized that Tituhuluyalimisi of the Wudawan tribe asked to come in tribute; permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported that Tituhuluyalimisi of the Wudawan tribe sought to present tribute; the request was approved.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，詔諸大臣家應請功臣號者，既不許其子孫自陳，吏部考功郎其詳考其勞績，當賜號者，即以聞。

translations.literal: On gengxu an edict said that in ministerial families entitled to meritorious titles, since sons and grandsons might not petition on their own, the Ministry of Personnel’s merit examiner should review their service in detail and report those due a title.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu an edict held that where ministerial houses merited a commendatory title, sons might not petition for themselves; the Ministry of Personnel’s merit examiner was to weigh their service and report those who qualified.

sentences.zh: 壬子，上謂宰臣曰：「宗室中年高者，往往未有官稱。

translations.literal: On renzi the emperor told the chief ministers: 「Among the imperial clansmen many who are already advanced in years still have no office.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi he told the chief ministers: 「Many clansmen of advanced age still hold no post.

sentences.zh: 其先皆有功于國，朕欲稍加以官，使有名位可稱，如何？

translations.literal: Their forebears all had merit for the state; I wish to give them office in modest measure so they have rank and standing—what do you think?」
translations.idiomatic: Their ancestors served the dynasty; I would like to grant them modest office so they have a name worth bearing—what say you?」

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「親親報功，先王之令則。

translations.literal: 」They replied: 「To cherish kin and reward merit is the constant rule of the ancient kings.」
translations.idiomatic: 」They answered: 「To honor kin and reward merit is the ancient kings’ unchanging way.」

sentences.zh: 」丁巳，詔朝官嫁娶給假三日，不須申告。

translations.literal: " On dingsi an edict granted court officials three days' leave for marriage without need to report.
translations.idiomatic: " On dingsi an edict gave court officials three days' wedding leave with no formal petition required.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，詔宰臣：「海陵時，大臣無辜被戮家屬籍沒者，並釋為良。

translations.literal: On renxu he instructed the chief ministers: "During Hailing's reign, when ministers were executed without cause and their households were registered and confiscated, all are to be released as free persons.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he told the chief ministers: "In Hailing's time, when ministers were killed without cause and their families were seized and enslaved, all such households are to be freed.

sentences.zh: 遼豫王、宋天水郡王被害子孫，各葬于廣甯、河南舊塋。

translations.literal: Descendants of the murdered Liao Prince of Yu and Song's Prince of Tianshui shall each be buried in the old graves at Guangning and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: The murdered Liao Prince of Yu's and Song Prince of Tianshui's descendants shall be buried each in the old cemeteries at Guangning and Henan.

sentences.zh: 」其後複昭：「天水郡王親屬于都北安葬外，咸平所寄骨殖，官為葬於本處。

translations.literal: " Later it was again proclaimed: "Apart from burying the Prince of Tianshui's kin north of the capital, for bone relics deposited at Xianping the officials shall bury them on site.
translations.idiomatic: " It was proclaimed again: "Besides interring the Prince of Tianshui's kin north of the capital, officials shall bury at the original sites any bone relics held at Xianping.

sentences.zh: 遼豫王親屬未入本塋者，亦遷祔之」。

translations.literal: Kin of the Liao Prince of Yu not yet placed in the ancestral graves shall also be moved and enshrined with them."
translations.idiomatic: Liao Prince of Yu kin not yet in the family graves shall likewise be moved and reburied with their forebears."

sentences.zh: 三月辛丑朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on xinchou the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on xinchou at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，詔免河北、山東、陝西、河東、西京、遼東等十路去年被旱、蝗租稅。

translations.literal: On xinhai an edict remitted last year's rent and tax for ten circuits—Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, Western Capital, Liaodong, and others—stricken by drought and locusts.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict waived last year's land tax in ten circuits including Hebei, Shandong, Shaanxi, Hedong, Western Capital, and Liaodong, wherever drought and locusts had struck.

sentences.zh: 賑東京、婆速、曷速館三路。

translations.literal: Relief was extended to the Eastern Capital, Pusur, and Yasuguan routes.
translations.idiomatic: Relief was ordered for the Eastern Capital, Pusur, and Yasuguan routes.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尚書省奏，三路之粟，不能周給。

translations.literal: On yichou the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that grain for the three routes could not fully supply them.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Ministry of Revenue reported that the three routes could not be fully supplied from local grain.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕嘗語卿等，遇豐年即廣糴以備凶歉。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "I have told you that in years of plenty grain should be bought widely to prepare for famine.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "I have told you that in good harvests the state should buy grain broadly against lean years.

sentences.zh: 卿等皆言天下倉廩盈溢。

translations.literal: You all said the empire's granaries overflowed.
translations.idiomatic: You assured me the realm's granaries were overflowing.

sentences.zh: 今欲賑濟，乃雲不給。

translations.literal: Now when I want relief, you say there is not enough.
translations.idiomatic: Now, when I would give relief, you say there is not enough.

sentences.zh: 自古帝王皆以蓄積為國家長計，朕之積粟，豈欲獨用之耶？

translations.literal: Since ancient times emperors have made storage the state's long-term plan—do I hoard grain for my own use alone?
translations.idiomatic: Since antiquity rulers have stored grain as a lasting policy for the realm—surely I do not stockpile it for myself alone?

sentences.zh: 今既不給，可於鄰道取之以濟。

translations.literal: Since it is not enough now, take from neighboring circuits to supply relief.
translations.idiomatic: If stocks here fall short, draw from neighboring circuits to make up the relief.

sentences.zh: 自今預備，當以為常。」

translations.literal: From now on such preparation shall be regular practice."
