translations.idiomatic: Hereafter treat such preparation as standing practice."

sentences.zh: 四月甲戌，制世襲猛安謀克若出仕者，雖年未及六十，欲令子孫襲者，聽。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jiaxu, regulations were set: hereditary meng'an and mouke who enter office, though not yet sixty, if they wish their descendants to inherit, it is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jiaxu, the court ruled that hereditary meng'an and mouke in office who are not yet sixty may, if they wish, let descendants succeed them.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，諭宰臣曰：「郡縣之官雖以罪解，一二歲後，亦須再用。

translations.literal: On wuyin he told the chief ministers: "Although prefectural and county magistrates are dismissed for crime, after one or two years they should still be reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin he told the chief ministers: "Even magistrates removed for offenses should, after a year or two, be given office again.

sentences.zh: 猛安謀克皆太祖創業之際于國勤勞有功之人，其世襲之官，不宜以小罪奪免。

translations.literal: Meng'an and mouke were all men who toiled in merit for the state at Taizu's founding—their hereditary posts should not be stripped for minor crimes."
translations.idiomatic: Meng'an and mouke are heirs of those who labored for the realm at the founding—their hereditary commissions must not be lost over trifling faults."

sentences.zh: 」戊子，以滕王府長史徒單烏者為橫賜高麗使。

translations.literal: " On wuzi Tushan Wuzhe, chief administrator of the Prince of Teng's household, was made side-gift envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: " On wuzi Tushan Wuzhe, chief administrator of the Prince of Teng's household, was sent as side-gift envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 五月，尚書省奏，定皇家袒免以上親燕饗班次，並從唐制。

translations.literal: Fifth month: the Ministry of Revenue memorialized, fixing the seating order at banquets for imperial clansmen within the mourning-uncovered degree and above, all following Tang practice.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the Ministry of Revenue fixed banquet seating for the imperial clan within one degree of mourning-uncovered kin, following Tang usage.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，幸姚村澱，閱七品以下官及宗室子、諸局承應人射柳，賞有差。

translations.literal: On guimao he visited Yao Village Marsh, reviewed willow-shooting by officials of seventh rank and below, imperial clans youths, and clerks of the various bureaus, and gave rewards in differing grades.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he went to Yao Village Marsh to watch willow-shooting by officials of seventh rank and below, young clansmen, and bureau clerks, with graded prizes for winners.

sentences.zh: 六月乙卯，謂宰臣曰：「朕年老矣！

translations.literal: Sixth month, on yimao, he told the chief ministers: "I am old!
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on yimao, he told the chief ministers: "I am old!

sentences.zh: 恐因一時喜怒，處置有所不當，卿等即當執奏，毋為面從，成朕之失。

translations.literal: Fearing that in a moment of anger I might act improperly, you must remonstrate at once—do not agree to my face and thereby complete my faults."
translations.idiomatic: Lest a fit of anger lead me to decide wrongly, speak up at once—do not flatter me to my face and thereby share my errors."

sentences.zh: 」乙未，以英王爽之子思列為忠順軍節度副使。

translations.literal: " On yiwei Prince Ying Shuang's son Silie was made deputy military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army.
translations.idiomatic: " On yiwei Silie, son of Prince Ying Shuang, was made deputy military commissioner of the Zhongshun Army.

sentences.zh: 爽入謝，上曰：「朕以卿疾故，特任卿子，所冀卿因喜而愈也。

translations.literal: Shuang came to give thanks; the emperor said: "Because of your illness I specially appointed your son, hoping you might be cured through joy.
translations.idiomatic: Shuang came to thank him; the emperor said: "Your illness moved me to advance your son, hoping gladness might aid your recovery.

sentences.zh: 欲即加峻授，恐思列年幼，未閑政事。

translations.literal: I wished at once to grant a higher post but feared Silie is too young and not yet versed in administration.
translations.idiomatic: I would have promoted him further at once, but Silie is still young and unpracticed in government.

sentences.zh: 汝當訓之，使有善可觀，更當升擢。」

translations.literal: You must instruct him so that he shows something worthy to be seen; then he will be promoted again."
translations.idiomatic: Train him until he shows real merit worthy of notice; then he shall rise again."

sentences.zh: 七月壬子，尚書省奏，歲以羊三萬賜西北路戍兵，上問如何運致，宰臣不能對。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on renzi, the Ministry of Revenue memorialized that each year thirty thousand sheep are given to Northwest Route frontier troops; the emperor asked how transport was to be arranged, and the chief ministers could not answer.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on renzi, the Ministry of Revenue reported thirty thousand sheep given yearly to Northwest Route frontier troops; the emperor asked how they were to be delivered, and the chief ministers had no answer.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「朕雖退朝，留凡政務，不遑安寧。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Though I leave court, I still review every item of government and find no leisure.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Even after court I go through routine business and cannot rest.

sentences.zh: 卿等勿謂細事非帝王所宜問，以卿等於國家之事未嘗用心，故問之耳。

translations.literal: Do not think small matters are unworthy of an emperor's inquiry—I ask because you have never applied your minds to affairs of state."
translations.idiomatic: Do not suppose small affairs are beneath an emperor's notice—I question you because you give no thought to the realm's business."

sentences.zh: 」是月，大雨，河決。

translations.literal: " That month heavy rain fell and the river breached its banks.
translations.idiomatic: " That month came heavy rains and the river broke its dikes.

sentences.zh: 八月己巳，觀稼於近郊。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on jisi, he viewed the harvest in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on jisi, he inspected crops near the capital.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以監察禦察御史體察東北路官吏，輒受訟牒，為不稱職，笞之五十。

translations.literal: On renshen, because investigating censor on tour in the Northeast Route accepted litigation documents at will and was unfit for office, he was beaten fifty strokes.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen a touring inspector on the Northeast Route was flogged fifty strokes for taking petitions at will and unfit service.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，上謂宰臣曰：「今之在官者，同僚所見，事雖當理，必以為非，意謂從之則恐人謂政非己出。

translations.literal: On gengchen the emperor told the chief ministers: "Officials today, in what their colleagues observe, even when a matter is reasonable must call it wrong, thinking that to agree would make it seem the policy was not their own.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he told the chief ministers: "Men in office today, among colleagues, reject sound proposals for fear agreement would credit someone else with the policy.

sentences.zh: 如此者多，朕甚不取。

translations.literal: There are many such—I greatly disapprove.
translations.idiomatic: Such cases are common, and I deeply dislike it.

sentences.zh: 今觀大理寺所斷，雖制有正條，理不能行者別具情見，朕惟取其所長。

translations.literal: Now observing Grand Court of Judicature decisions: though the code has proper articles, when reason cannot be applied they set out separate circumstances—I take only what is excellent.
translations.idiomatic: In the Grand Court of Judicature, when the statutes cannot meet reason, they add explanatory findings—I keep what is sound in them.

sentences.zh: 夫為人之理，他人之善者從之，則可謂善矣。

translations.literal: In human conduct, if one follows another's goodness one may be called good."
translations.idiomatic: In affairs among men, adopting what is good in another is itself goodness."

sentences.zh: 」壬午，上謂宰臣曰：「今在下僚豈無人材，但在上者不為汲引，惡其材勝己故耳。

translations.literal: " On renwu he again told the chief ministers: "Surely talent exists among lower officials; it is only that superiors do not draw them up, hating that their talent may surpass their own."
translations.idiomatic: " On renwu he again told the chief ministers: "Able men surely exist in the lower ranks; superiors fail to lift them because they loathe being outshone."

sentences.zh: 」丙戌，上謂御史中丞紇石烈邈曰：「台臣糾察吏治之能否，務去其擾民，且冀其得賢也。

translations.literal: " On bingxu he told Censor-in-Chief Heishilie Yao: "Censors investigate whether officials govern well or badly, seeking to remove those who harass the people and hoping to gain the worthy.
translations.idiomatic: " On bingxu he told Censor-in-Chief Heishilie Yao: "Censors exist to test officers' conduct, clear away those who vex the people, and bring forward the worthy.

sentences.zh: 今所至輒受訟牒，聽其妄告，使為政者如何則可也。」

translations.literal: Now wherever they arrive they accept litigation documents and heed groundless accusations—how can magistrates govern under such conditions?"
translations.idiomatic: Yet wherever they go they take suits and indulge false charges—how are magistrates to govern?"

sentences.zh: 九月丁酉朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on dingyou the new moon, there was a solar eclipse.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on dingyou at the new moon, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，封子永德為薛王。

translations.literal: On xinmao his son Yongde was enfeoffed Prince of Xue.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao his son Yongde was enfeoffed as Prince of Xue.

sentences.zh: 以右副都點檢完顏習尼烈等為賀宋生日使。

translations.literal: Right Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wanyan Xinilie and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Right Deputy Director of Palace Attendants Wanyan Xinilie and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以兵部郎中石抹忽土為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On guimao Ministry of War bureau chief Shimo Hutu was made Western Xia birthday envoy.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Shimo Hutu of the Ministry of War was sent as Western Xia birthday envoy.

sentences.zh: 戊申，秋獵。

translations.literal: On wushen the autumn hunt was held.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，歲星、熒惑、太白聚於尾。

translations.literal: On gengxu Jupiter, Mars, and Venus gathered at the Tail mansion.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Jupiter, Mars, and Venus met in the Tail asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲子，還都。

translations.literal: On jiazi he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十月己巳，夏國進百頭帳，詔卻之境上。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on jisi, Western Xia presented a tribute of hundred-head tents; an edict had them refused at the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on jisi, Western Xia offered hundred-head tents; an edict had the gift turned back at the border.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，有司奏：「衍慶宮所畫功臣二十人，惟五人有諡，今考檢餘十五人功狀，擬定諡號以進。

translations.literal: On guiyou the relevant offices memorialized: "Of the twenty meritorious ministers painted at Yanqing Palace only five have posthumous titles; we have now examined the merits of the remaining fifteen and propose posthumous names for submission.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou the offices reported: "At Yanqing Palace twenty meritorious ministers are painted, but only five bear posthumous styles; we have reviewed the other fifteen and draft titles for approval.

sentences.zh: 」詔可，詔以羊十萬付烏古裏石壘部畜牧，其滋息以予貧民。

translations.literal: " The edict approved; an edict gave one hundred thousand sheep to the Wuguri Shilei tribe for pasturage, its increase to be given to poor households.
translations.idiomatic: " The court assented; it also ordered one hundred thousand sheep entrusted to the Wuguri Shilei tribe for grazing, with the increase distributed to the poor.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，制諸猛安，父任別職，子須年二十五以上方許承襲。

translations.literal: On dingchou an order to all meng'an: if the father holds another office, the son must be twenty-five years or older before hereditary succession is permitted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the court ruled that among all meng'an, where the father serves in another post the son must be at least twenty-five before he may inherit the company.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，上謂宰臣曰：「今在位不聞薦賢，何也？

translations.literal: On xinsi the emperor told the chief ministers: "Those in office today are never heard recommending the worthy—why is that?
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi the emperor asked the chief ministers: "Why do those in office today never recommend able men?"

sentences.zh: 昔狄仁傑起自下僚，力扶唐祚，使既危而安，延數百年之永。

translations.literal: In old times Di Renjie rose from the lower ranks and greatly supported the house of Tang, turning what was already perilous into safety and extending its endurance for centuries.
translations.idiomatic: Long ago Di Renjie came up from humble posts and steadied the Tang throne when it was already failing, giving the dynasty centuries more life.

sentences.zh: 仁傑雖賢，非婁師德何以自薦乎？

translations.literal: Though Renjie was worthy, without Lou Shide how could he have recommended himself?
translations.idiomatic: Renjie was worthy—but without Lou Shide to put him forward, how could he have risen?

sentences.zh: 」癸未，更護送罪人逃亡制。

translations.literal: " On guiwei the regulations on escorting convicts who flee were revised.
translations.idiomatic: " On guiwei the rules governing escorts when convicts escape were changed.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「近觀上封章者，殊無大利害。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "Lately I have read memorials to the throne, and they are quite without great benefit or harm.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief ministers: "The memorials I have read lately are of little real consequence either way.

sentences.zh: 且古之諫者既忠於國，亦以求名，今之諫者為利而已。

translations.literal: In antiquity remonstrators were loyal to the state and also sought a name; today's remonstrators seek profit only.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient remonstrators served the realm and sought renown as well; today's remonstrators want profit alone.

sentences.zh: 如戶部尚書曹望之、濟南尹梁肅皆上書言事，蓋覬覦執政耳，其于國政竟何所補。

translations.literal: For example, Minister of Revenue Cao Wangzhi and Jinan Intendant Liang Su both memorialized—clearly they coveted high office; what did they add to state affairs?
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Revenue Cao Wangzhi and Jinan Intendant Liang Su, for instance, both submitted memorials—plainly angling for the council; what did that do for government?

sentences.zh: 達官如此，況餘人乎！

translations.literal: When high officials are thus, how much more the rest!
translations.idiomatic: If great ministers act so, what of the rest!

sentences.zh: 昔海陵南伐，太醫使祁宰極諫，至戮於市，此本朝以來一人而已。

translations.literal: In Hailing's southern campaign Imperial Medical Commissioner Qi Zai remonstrated to the limit and was executed in the marketplace—alone in this dynasty since antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Under Hailing's southern campaign Imperial Medical Commissioner Qi Zai spoke out to the end and was put to death in the market—the only such case in our house since the founding.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，上命宰臣曰：「監察御史田忠孺嘗上書言事，今當升擢，以勵其餘。」

translations.literal: " On dinghai the emperor ordered the chief ministers: "Investigating Censor Tian Zhongru once memorialized; he should now be promoted to encourage the rest."
translations.idiomatic: " On dinghai the emperor told the chief ministers: "Investigating Censor Tian Zhongru once submitted a memorial; promote him now to hearten the others."

sentences.zh: 十一月戊戌，以南京留守徒單克甯為平章政事。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on wuxu, Southern Capital regent Tudan Kening was made associate administration councillor.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuxu, Southern Capital regent Tudan Kening became associate administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，上謂宰臣曰：「朕常恐重斂以困吾民，自今諸路差科之煩細者，亦具以聞。

translations.literal: On gengxu the emperor told the chief ministers: "I constantly fear heavy levies will distress my people; from now on even the minute levies on the various routes should also be reported.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu he told the chief ministers: "I always dread that heavy exactions will crush the people; hereafter report even the smallest levies on every route.

sentences.zh: 」有司奏，夏國進禦帳使因邊臣懇求進入，乃許之。

translations.literal: " The departments reported that the Western Xia envoy to enter the imperial tent had been allowed in at frontier officials' earnest request.
translations.idiomatic: " The departments reported that a Xia envoy seeking entry to the imperial tent had been admitted at frontier officers' urgent plea.

sentences.zh: 以尚書左丞石琚為平章政事。

translations.literal: Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat Shi Ju was made associate administration councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Left Assistant Director Shi Ju became associate administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以延安尹完顏蒲剌睹等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On bingchen Yan'an Intendant Wanyan Puladu and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Wanyan Puladu, intendant of Yan'an, and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊辰，以渤海舊俗男女婚娶多不以禮，必先攘竊以奔，詔禁絕之，犯者以奸論。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on wuchen, because in old Bohai custom men and women often married without ritual and first seized and eloped, an edict forbade it; offenders were judged as adulterers.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuchen, an edict ended the old Bohai practice of marrying without rites by abduction and flight; offenders were punished as adulterers.

sentences.zh: 以宿直將軍僕散懷忠為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: Night-duty general Pusan Huaizhong was made envoy for Goryeo's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: Night-duty general Pusan Huaizhong was sent as envoy for Goryeo's birthday.

sentences.zh: 己巳，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On jisi Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以尚書右丞唐括安禮為左丞，殿前都點檢蒲察通為右丞。

translations.literal: On renshen Left Assistant Director Tangkuo Anli was made left assistant director; Palace Front commander Pucha Tong was made right assistant director.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Left Assistant Director Tangkuo Anli became left assistant director, and Palace Front commander Pucha Tong right assistant director.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰執曰：「朕今年已五十有五，若年逾六十，雖欲有為，而莫之能矣！

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief executives: "I am already fifty-five; if I pass sixty, though I wish to act, I shall not be able!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief executives: "I am already fifty-five; past sixty, even if I wish to act, I cannot!

sentences.zh: 宜及朕之康強，其女直人猛安謀克及國家政事之未完，與夫法令之未一者，宜皆修舉之。

translations.literal: While I am still strong, the Jurchen meng'an and mouke and what remains unfinished in state affairs, and where statutes are not yet uniform, should all be put in order.
translations.idiomatic: While I am still vigorous, Jurchen meng'an and mouke, unfinished government business, and laws not yet made one should all be brought to completion.

sentences.zh: 凡所施行，朕不為怠。」

translations.literal: In whatever I carry out, I will not be slack."
translations.idiomatic: In what I undertake I will not grow idle."

sentences.zh: 十八年正月丙申朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Eighteenth year, first month, on bingchen the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, first month, on bingchen at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，定殺異居周親奴婢、同居卑幼，輒殺奴婢及妻無罪而輒毆殺者罪。

translations.literal: On renyin penalties were fixed for killing a slave of a collateral kinsman in a separate household; for junior kin in the same household who kill slaves; and for beating a wife to death without cause.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin statutes set punishments for killing a collateral kinsman's slave in another household, for co-resident juniors who kill slaves, and for beating an innocent wife to death.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，修起居注移剌傑上書言：「每屏人議事，雖史官亦不與聞，無由紀錄。

translations.literal: On gengxu Veritable Records compiler Yelü Jie memorialized: "Whenever the emperor discusses affairs in private, even the historiographers are not admitted, and there is no way to record them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Veritable Records compiler Yelü Jie wrote: "Whenever Your Majesty confers in private, even the court historians are shut out, so nothing can be written down.

sentences.zh: 」上以問平章政事石琚、左丞唐括安禮，對曰：「古者，天子置史官于左右，言動必書，所以儆戒人君，庶幾有所畏也。

translations.literal: " The emperor asked Associate Administration Councillor Shi Ju and Left Assistant Director Tangkuo Anli, who replied: "In antiquity the Son of Heaven placed historians at his side; every word and act was written down to warn the ruler, so that he might have something to fear.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked Shi Ju and Tangkuo Anli, who answered: "In antiquity rulers kept historians at hand; every word and deed was recorded to admonish the throne, so the sovereign might feel restraint.

sentences.zh: 」庚申，免中都、河北、河東、山東、河南、陝西等路前年被災租稅。

translations.literal: " On gengshen rent and tax for the prior year's disasters in the Central Capital, Hebei, Hedong, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and other routes was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengshen last year's disaster taxes were waived in the Central Capital, Hebei, Hedong, Shandong, Henan, Shaanxi, and other circuits.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，如春水。

translations.literal: On renxu he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu he went to the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 二月丙寅朔，次管莊。

translations.literal: Second month, on bingyin the new moon, he halted at Guanzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on bingyin at the new moon, he paused at Guanzhuang.

sentences.zh: 丙子，次華港。

translations.literal: On bingzi he halted at Hua Harbor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he paused at Hua Harbor.

sentences.zh: 己丑，還宮。

translations.literal: On jichou he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on yiwei the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yiwei at the new moon, the Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，命戍邊女直人遇祭祀、婚嫁、節辰許自造酒。

translations.literal: On dingwei an order allowed Jurchen on the frontier, when sacrifices, weddings, or seasonal festivals occurred, to brew wine for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei border Jurchen were permitted to brew wine for sacrifices, weddings, and festival days.

sentences.zh: 丁未，上謂宰執曰：「縣令之職最為親民，當得賢材用之。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief executives: "The office of county magistrate is closest to the people and ought to be filled with able men.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor told the chief executives: "County magistrates stand nearest the people and should be men of talent.

sentences.zh: 邇來犯法者眾，殊不聞有能者。

translations.literal: Lately many break the law, and one hears of none who are capable.
translations.idiomatic: Lately lawbreakers are many, and no capable men are reported.

sentences.zh: 比在春水，見石城、玉田兩縣令，皆年老，苟祿而已。

translations.literal: Recently at the spring waters I saw the magistrates of Shicheng and Yutian—both old men clinging to salary only.
translations.idiomatic: At the spring waters I lately met the magistrates of Shicheng and Yutian—both elderly, holding office only for the stipend.

sentences.zh: 畿甸尚爾，遠縣可知。

translations.literal: If the capital region is thus, distant counties may be imagined.
translations.idiomatic: If the capital districts are so, the distant counties can be guessed.

sentences.zh: 」平章政事石琚對曰：」良鄉令焦旭、慶都令李伯達皆能吏，可任。

translations.literal: " Associate Administration Councillor Shi Ju replied: "Magistrate Jiao Xu of Liangxiang and Magistrate Li Boda of Qingdu are both capable officials and may be appointed.
translations.idiomatic: " Shi Ju replied: "Jiao Xu of Liangxiang and Li Boda of Qingdu are able magistrates and fit for appointment.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「審如卿言，可擢用之。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "If it is as you say, they may be promoted and used.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "If that is so, promote them.

sentences.zh: 」己酉，禁民間無得創興寺觀。

translations.literal: " On jiyou the people were forbidden to found temples and monasteries on their own.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou private persons were barred from erecting temples and monasteries.

sentences.zh: 獻州人殷小二等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: Yin Xiao'er and others of Xian Prefecture plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Yin Xiao'er and others of Xian Prefecture plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 四月己巳，上謂宰臣曰：「朕巡幸所至，必令體訪官吏臧否。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jisi, the emperor told the chief ministers: "Wherever I tour I always order inquiry into officials' good and bad conduct.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jisi, he told the chief ministers: "On every tour I order officials' conduct investigated.

sentences.zh: 向玉田知主簿石抹杳乃能吏也，可授本縣令。

translations.literal: The chief clerk Shimo Yaonai at Yutian is a capable man and may be given this county's magistracy.
translations.idiomatic: Shimo Yaonai, chief clerk at Yutian, is capable and may be made magistrate of that county.

sentences.zh: 」己丑，以太子左贊善阿不罕德甫為橫賜夏國使。

translations.literal: " On jichou Crown Prince Left Tutor Abuhan Defu was made side-gift envoy to Western Xia.
translations.idiomatic: " On jichou Crown Prince Left Tutor Abuhan Defu was sent as side-gift envoy to Western Xia.

sentences.zh: 五月丙午，上如金蓮川。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingwu, he went to Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingwu, he went to Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 六月庚午，尚書左丞相紇石烈良弼薨。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on gengwu, Left Chancellor of the Secretariat Heshilie Liangbi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on gengwu, Left Chancellor Heshilie Liangbi died.

sentences.zh: 閏月辛丑，命賑西南、西北兩招討司民，及烏古裏石壘部轉戶饑。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, on xinchou, orders were issued to relieve the people of the Southwest and Northwest Pacification Commissions and the transhumant households of the Wuguri Shilei tribe suffering famine.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on xinchou, relief was ordered for the Southwest and Northwest Pacification Commissions and for famine among transhumant households of the Wuguri Shilei tribe.

sentences.zh: 七月丙子，上謂宰臣曰：「職官始犯贓罪，容有過誤，至於再犯，是無改過之心。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on bingzi, the emperor told the chief ministers: "When an official first commits graft there may be error; to commit it again shows no mind to reform.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on bingzi, he told the chief ministers: "A first offense in bribery may be a mistake; a second proves no intent to mend.

sentences.zh: 自今再犯不以贓數多寡，並除名。」

translations.literal: From now on a second offense, regardless of the amount of graft, shall bring dismissal from office."
translations.idiomatic: Hereafter a second bribery offense, whatever the sum, means removal from office."

sentences.zh: 八月乙巳，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on yisi, he returned from Jinlian River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on yisi, he returned from Jinlian River.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以尚書右丞相完顏守道為左丞相，平章政事石琚為右丞相。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Right Chancellor of the Secretariat Wanyan Shoudao was made left chancellor, and Administration Councillor Shi Ju was made right chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Right Chancellor Wanyan Shoudao became left chancellor, and Administration Councillor Shi Ju right chancellor.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以大理卿張九思等為賀宋生日使，侍御史完顏蒲魯虎為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on xinwei, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Zhang Jiusi and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; Attendant Censor Wanyan Puluhu was envoy for the Xia ruler’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on xinwei, Director Zhang Jiusi of the Court of Judicial Review and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor’s birthday; Attendant Censor Wanyan Puluhu was envoy for the Xia ruler’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以尚書左丞唐括安禮為平章政事。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Left Vice Director Tangguo Anli was made administration councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Left Vice Director Tangguo Anli became administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以右丞蒲察通為左丞，參知政事移剌道為右丞，刑部尚書粘割斡特剌為參知政事。

translations.literal: On yihai, Right Vice Director Pucha Tong was made left vice director, Participation Councillor Yelü Dao was made right vice director, and Minister of Justice Niange Watele was made participation councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Right Vice Director Pucha Tong became left vice director, Participation Councillor Yelü Dao right vice director, and Minister of Justice Niange Watele participation councillor.

sentences.zh: 十月庚寅朔，陝州防禦使石抹靳家奴以罪除名。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on gengyin at the new moon, Shaanzhou defense commissioner Shimo Qinjianu was struck from the register for crime.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengyin at the new moon, Shaanzhou defense commissioner Shimo Qinjianu was expelled from office for a crime.

sentences.zh: 甲午，御史中丞劉仲誨、侍御史李瑜坐失糾察大長公主事，各削官一階。

translations.literal: On jiawu, Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui and Attendant Censor Li Yu, for failing to investigate the Grand Elder Princess affair, each had one rank stripped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Censor-in-Chief Liu Zhonghui and Attendant Censor Li Yu, for neglecting to investigate the Grand Elder Princess matter, each lost one rank.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚申朔，尚書省奏，擬同知永甯軍節度使事阿可為刺史，上曰：「阿可年幼，於事未練，授佐貳官可也。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on gengshen at the new moon, the Secretariat memorialized proposing A Ke, associate administrator of Yongning circuit, as prefect; the emperor said: "A Ke is young and unseasoned in affairs—a deputy second-rank post will do.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on gengshen at the new moon, the Secretariat proposed A Ke, associate administrator of Yongning circuit, for prefect; the emperor said: "A Ke is still young and inexperienced—a deputy second-rank post is enough.

sentences.zh: 」平章政事唐括安禮奏曰：「臣等以阿可宗室，故擬是職。

translations.literal: " Administration Councillor Tangguo Anli memorialized: "We proposed that post because A Ke is of the imperial clan."
translations.idiomatic: " Administration Councillor Tangguo Anli replied: "We chose that office because he is of the imperial clan."

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「郡守系千里休戚，安可不擇人而私其親耶？

translations.literal: The emperor said: "A prefect holds the weal and woe of a thousand li—how can one favor kin without choosing the man?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "A prefect’s charge is the welfare of a whole region—how can kinship override choosing the right man?

sentences.zh: 若以親親之恩，賜與雖厚，無害於政。

translations.literal: If affection for kin calls for generous gifts, that does no harm to government.
translations.idiomatic: Kin may be rewarded lavishly without hurting the state.

sentences.zh: 使之治郡而非其才，一境何賴焉。

translations.literal: But to put him in charge of a commandery when he lacks the talent—what can that land rely on?"
translations.idiomatic: To let him govern a commandery without the ability—what hope has that land?"

sentences.zh: 」壬申，以靜難軍節度使烏延查剌等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Jingnan military commissioner Wuyan Zhala and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year’s Day.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Jingnan military commissioner Wuyan Zhala and others were appointed envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 丙子，尚書省奏，崇信縣令石安節買車材於部民，三日不償其直，當削官一階，解職。

translations.literal: On bingzi, the Secretariat memorialized that Chongxin county magistrate Shi Anjie had bought cart timber from people under his jurisdiction and, after three days, had not paid the price; he should lose one rank and be removed from office.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi the Secretariat reported that Chongxin magistrate Shi Anjie had bought cart timber from his subjects and failed to pay after three days; he was to lose one rank and leave office.

sentences.zh: 上因言：「凡在官者，但當取其貪污與清白之尤者數人黜陟之，則人自知懲勸矣。

translations.literal: The emperor then said: "For all who hold office, take only the most corrupt and the most upright—several of each—and promote or demote them; then people will know reward and warning of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor added: "Among officials, pick out only the worst grafters and the clearest honest men—a few of each—and move them up or down; the rest will take warning on their own.

sentences.zh: 夫朝廷之政，太寬則人不知懼，太猛則小玷亦將不免於罪，惟當用中典耳。

translations.literal: Court policy that is too lenient leaves men without fear; too harsh and even small faults will not escape punishment—only the mean between them will do."
translations.idiomatic: If policy is too soft, men feel no dread; if too harsh, even petty faults draw punishment—hold to the middle way."

sentences.zh: 」戊寅，上責宰臣曰：「近問趙承元何故再任，卿等言，曹王嘗遣人言其才能幹敏，故再任之。

translations.literal: On wuyin the emperor rebuked the chief ministers: "When I lately asked why Zhao Chengyuan was appointed again, you said the Prince of Cao had sent word that he was able and diligent, and so he was reappointed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the emperor scolded the chief ministers: "When I asked why Zhao Chengyuan was given office again, you said the Prince of Cao had praised his ability and diligence, and you put him back.

sentences.zh: 官爵擬注，雖由卿輩，予奪之權，當出於朕。

translations.literal: Drafting and posting of rank may lie with you, but the power to grant and withdraw belongs to me.
translations.idiomatic: You may draft appointments, but grant and recall are mine alone.

sentences.zh: 曹王之言尚從之，假皇太子有所諭，則其從可知矣。

translations.literal: If you still follow the Prince of Cao’s word, how much more would you follow a royal heir’s instruction?
translations.idiomatic: You heed even the Prince of Cao—were the crown prince to speak, your compliance is obvious.

sentences.zh: 此事因卿言始知，其不知者知複幾何？

translations.literal: I learned of this only because you spoke of it—how much more do I not know?"
translations.idiomatic: I know of this affair only because you mentioned it—how much else never reaches me?"

sentences.zh: 且卿等公受請屬，可乎？

translations.literal: And do you openly accept private requests—is that permissible?"
translations.idiomatic: And is it right for you to take private petitions in the open?"

sentences.zh: 」蓋承元前為曹王府文學，與王邸婢奸，杖百五十除名，而複用也。

translations.literal: Chengyuan had earlier been literary instructor in the Prince of Cao’s household; he lay with a palace maid of the prince’s residence, was flogged one hundred fifty strokes and expelled, and was now reemployed.
translations.idiomatic: Chengyuan had been literary tutor in the Prince of Cao’s household, committed adultery with a maidservant there, was flogged one hundred fifty times and expelled, and was now restored.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以吏部尚書烏古論元忠為御史大夫，以東上閣門使左光慶為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On bingxu, Minister of Personnel Wugulun Yuanzhong was made censor-in-chief, and Eastern Upper Gate commissioner Zuo Guangqing was made envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Minister of Personnel Wugulun Yuanzhong became censor-in-chief, and Eastern Upper Gate commissioner Zuo Guangqing was sent as envoy for Goryeo’s birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚戌，封孫吾都補溫國公，麻達葛金源郡王，承慶道國公。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on gengxu, grandsons Wen Dubu was enfeoffed Duke of Wen, Madage Prince of Jinyuan, and Chengqing Duke of Dao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on gengxu, grandsons Wen Dubu was made Duke of Wen, Madage Prince of Jinyuan, and Chengqing Duke of Dao.

sentences.zh: 壬子，群臣奉上「大金受命萬世之寶。」

translations.literal: On renzi, the ministers presented the seal "Great Jin, Mandate Received for Ten Thousand Generations."
translations.idiomatic: On renzi the ministers presented the seal "Great Jin: Mandate Received for Ten Thousand Generations."

sentences.zh: 十九年正月庚申朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Year nineteen, first month, on gengshen at the new moon; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year nineteen, on gengshen at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，如春水。

translations.literal: On dingmao, he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he went to the spring hunt.

sentences.zh: 二月己酉，還宮。

translations.literal: Second month, on jiyou, he returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jiyou, he returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，免去年被水旱民田租稅。

translations.literal: On yimao, last year’s land tax was remitted for people whose fields suffered flood or drought.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao last year’s land tax was waived for fields stricken by flood or drought.

sentences.zh: 三月乙未朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on yimao at the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on yimao at the new moon, the Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，尚書省奏，虧課院務官顏葵等六十八人，各合削官一階。

translations.literal: On yichou, the Secretariat memorialized that sixty-eight monopoly-bureau officials, including Yan Kui, who had failed to meet revenue quotas, should each lose one rank.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the Secretariat reported that sixty-eight monopoly officials, including Yan Kui, who had fallen short of their quotas should each lose one rank.

sentences.zh: 上曰：「以承廢人主榷沽，此遼法也。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "Putting discharged men in charge of state monopolies—that is Liao law.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "Assigning dismissed men to run state monopolies is Liao practice.

sentences.zh: 法弊則當更張，唐、宋法有可行者則行之。

translations.literal: When a law is worn out it should be changed; where Tang and Song methods can be used, use them."
translations.idiomatic: When a law fails, reform it; adopt whatever from Tang and Song will work."

sentences.zh: 」己巳，上與宰臣論史事，且曰：「朕觀前史多溢美。

translations.literal: On jisi, the emperor discussed historical writing with the chief ministers and said: "When I read earlier histories, I find much empty praise.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, speaking with the chief ministers about history, he said: "Earlier histories I read are full of flattery.

sentences.zh: 大抵史書載事貴實，不必浮辭諂諛也。

translations.literal: In general what histories record should be true; there is no need for inflated words of adulation."
translations.idiomatic: Histories should record facts; there is no call for flowery praise."

sentences.zh: 」辛未，上謂宰臣曰：「奸邪之臣，欲有規求，往往私其黨與，不肯明言，托以他事，陽不與而陰為之力。

translations.literal: On xinwei, the emperor told the chief ministers: "Treacherous ministers who seek private gain often favor their faction in secret, unwilling to speak plainly; they plead some other matter, openly refusing while secretly lending force.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he told the chief ministers: "Wicked ministers angling for profit hide their clique and will not speak openly; they cite other business, refusing in public while pushing in secret.

sentences.zh: 朕觀古之奸人，當國家建儲之時，恐其聰明不利於己，往往風以陰事，破壞其議，惟擇昏懦者立之，冀他日可弄權為功利也。

translations.literal: I see that in antiquity, when a state was establishing an heir, fearing a clever prince would harm them, they often whispered dark tales to break the choice and set up only the dull and weak, hoping later to twist power for profit.
translations.idiomatic: Ancient traitors, when an heir was to be chosen, feared a clever prince and spread secret slanders to wreck the deliberation, backing only the dull and timid so they could play power for gain later.

sentences.zh: 如晉武欲立其弟，而奸臣沮之，竟立惠帝，以致喪亂，此明驗也。

translations.literal: Jin Wu wished to install his younger brother, but wicked ministers blocked it and set up Emperor Hui instead, bringing ruin—clear proof."
translations.idiomatic: Jin Wu wanted his younger brother, but schemers blocked him and enthroned Emperor Hui, and the realm fell into chaos—a plain lesson."

sentences.zh: 」丁丑，上謂宰臣曰：「朕觀前代人臣將諫於朝，與父母妻子決，示以必死。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the emperor told the chief ministers: "I see that in former ages, when a minister was about to remonstrate at court, he took leave of parents, wife, and children as one who must die.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou he told the chief ministers: "In old times a minister about to remonstrate at court bade farewell to parents, wife, and children as to certain death.

sentences.zh: 同列目睹其死，亦不顧身，又為之諫。

translations.literal: Colleagues who saw him die did not spare themselves either, but remonstrated again.
translations.idiomatic: Those who watched him die did not hold back themselves but offered remonstrance again.

sentences.zh: 此盡忠于國者，人所難能也。

translations.literal: Such utter loyalty to the state is what few men can achieve."
translations.idiomatic: That is loyalty to the state at its fullest—few can match it."

sentences.zh: 」己卯，制糾彈之官知有犯法而不舉者，減犯人罪一等科之，關親者許回避。

translations.literal: On jimao, regulations were issued: if a censorial official knew of a lawbreaker and did not report it, his penalty was reduced one degree below the offender’s; relatives within the mourning circle might recuse themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao an edict ruled that censors who knew of crime and failed to report it were punished one grade lighter than the culprit; close kin might withdraw from the case.

sentences.zh: 上謂宰臣曰：「人多奉釋老，意欲徼福。

translations.literal: The emperor told the chief ministers: "Many people follow Buddhism and Daoism, hoping to win fortune by grace.
translations.idiomatic: He told the chief ministers: "Many follow Buddhism and Daoism, hoping to scrape together blessings.

sentences.zh: 朕蚤年亦頗惑之，旋悟其非。

translations.literal: In my youth I too was much misled, but I soon saw the error.
translations.idiomatic: I was much taken in myself when young, but soon knew better.

sentences.zh: 且上天立君，使之治民，若盤樂怠忽，欲以僥倖祈福，難矣！

translations.literal: Heaven sets up a ruler to govern the people; if he indulges in pleasure and neglects duty, yet hopes to gain blessing by chance, that is hard!
translations.idiomatic: Heaven appoints a ruler to govern the people; if he revels and slacks off yet hopes luck will bring blessing, he labors in vain!

sentences.zh: 果能愛養下民，上當天心，福必報之。

translations.literal: If he truly cherishes and nourishes the people below, he will match Heaven’s heart, and blessing will surely answer him."
translations.idiomatic: If he truly cares for his subjects, he will win Heaven’s favor, and blessing will follow of itself."

sentences.zh: 」四月己丑朔，詔賑西南路招討司所部民。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on jichou at the new moon, an edict ordered relief for the people under the Southwest Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on jichou at the new moon, an edict ordered relief for people under the Southwest Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以升祔閔宗，詔中外。

translations.literal: On jiyou, because Minzong was elevated in the ancestral temple, an edict was issued throughout court and country.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, with Minzong’s elevation in the ancestral temple, an edict went out to all within and without the court.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，歲星晝見。

translations.literal: On dingsi, Jupiter was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Jupiter appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 五月戊寅，幸太甯宮。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on wuyin, he visited Taining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on wuyin, he went to Taining Palace.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子朔，詔更定制條。

translations.literal: Sixth month, on wuzi at the new moon, an edict revised the code articles.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, on wuzi at the new moon, an edict revised the statutory articles.

sentences.zh: 七月辛未，有司奏擬趙王子石古乃人從，上不從，謂宰相曰：「兒罪尚幼，若奉承太過，使侈心滋大，卒難節抑，此不可長。

translations.literal: Seventh month, on xinwei, the responsible offices memorialized proposing attendants for Zhao Wang's son Shi Gunai; the emperor did not assent and told the chief ministers: "The princes are still young; if they are flattered too much, extravagant hearts will grow and in the end will be hard to restrain—this must not be indulged.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, on xinwei, the ministries proposed attendants for Prince of Zhao's son Shi Gunai; the emperor refused and told the chief ministers: "The princes are still young—flatter them too much and luxury takes root, hard to curb later; this cannot be allowed.

sentences.zh: 諸兒每入侍，當其語笑娛樂之際，朕必淵默，蒞之以嚴，庶其知朕教戒之意，使常畏慎而寡過也。

translations.literal: Whenever the princes attend in service, at moments of talk and laughter and amusement, I am always deep in silence and meet them with severity, so that they may know my intent to teach and admonish and always be fearful, cautious, and seldom in error."
translations.idiomatic: When my sons attend me and grow merry, I stay silent and stern, so they feel my discipline and remain wary and seldom err."

sentences.zh: 」癸酉，密州民許通等謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: " On guiyou, the people of Mizhou, Xu Tong and others, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: " On guiyou Xu Tong of Mizhou and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 丙子，太白晝見。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Venus was seen in daytime.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Venus appeared in daylight.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，至自太甯宮。

translations.literal: On gengchen, he returned from Taining Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen he returned from Taining Palace.

sentences.zh: 八月壬辰，尚書右丞相石琚致仕。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renchen, Right Chancellor of the Secretariat Shi Ju retired.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renchen, Right Chancellor Shi Ju retired from office.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以宋大觀錢當五用。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Song Daguan coins were ordered to circulate at a value of five.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Song Daguan coins were put into circulation at five-for-one valuation.

sentences.zh: 丙午，濟南民劉溪忠謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingwu, the people of Jinan, Liu Xizhong and others, plotted rebellion and were executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Liu Xizhong of Jinan and others plotted rebellion and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，以左宣徽使蒲察鼎壽等為賀宋生日使，太子左衛率府率裴滿胡剌為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on wuwu, Left Commissioner of the Palace Attendants' Office Pucha Dingshou and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday; Crown Prince Left Guard Commandery commander Peiman Hula was envoy for the Western Xia ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on wuwu, Left Commissioner Pucha Dingshou and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday; Crown Prince Left Guard commander Peiman Hula was envoy for the Xia ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，秋獵。

translations.literal: On guihai, the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 癸未，還都。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 十月辛卯，西南路招討使哲典以贓罪，伏誅。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on xinmao, Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Zhe Dian was executed for graft.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on xinmao, Southwest Route Pacification Commissioner Zhe Dian was put to death for bribery.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，制知情服內成親者，雖自首仍依律坐之。

translations.literal: On xinhai, a regulation was issued: those who knowingly marry during the mourning period, though they confess, are still punished according to law.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai an edict ruled that marriage during mourning, even if confessed, still incurred legal punishment.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬戌，改葬昭德皇后，大赦。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on renxu, Empress Zhaode was reburied and a general amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on renxu, Empress Zhaode was reburied and a general amnesty was issued.

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞移剌綎等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: Yila Shuo, vice censor-in-chief, and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: Vice Censor-in-Chief Yila Shuo and others were sent as Song New Year envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，以西上閣門使盧拱為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: On wuchen, Western Upper Gate Commissioner Lu Gong was made envoy for Goryeo's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen Western Upper Gate Commissioner Lu Gong was sent as envoy for Goryeo's birthday.

sentences.zh: 壬申，上如河間冬獵。

translations.literal: On renshen, the emperor went to Hejian for the winter hunt.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen he went to Hejian for the winter hunt.

sentences.zh: 癸未，至自河間。

translations.literal: On guiwei, he returned from Hejian.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei he returned from Hejian.

sentences.zh: 二十年正月甲寅朔，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Twentieth year, first month, on jiayin at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, first month, on jiayin at the new moon, Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 戊午，定試令史格。

translations.literal: On wuwu, standards for examining clerks were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu standards for examining clerks were set.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，命歲以錢五千貫造隨朝百官節酒及冰、燭、藥、炭，視品秩給之。

translations.literal: On renxu, it was ordered that each year five thousand strings of cash be spent to supply court officials with festival wine, ice, candles, medicine, and charcoal, given according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu the court ordered five thousand strings of cash spent yearly on festival wine, ice, candles, medicine, and charcoal for officials at court, apportioned by rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，如春水。

translations.literal: On jisi, he went to the spring waters.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi he went to the spring waters.

sentences.zh: 丙子，幸石城縣行宮。

translations.literal: On bingzi, he visited the traveling palace at Shicheng County.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi he visited the traveling palace at Shicheng County.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以玉田縣行宮之地偏林為禦林，大澱濼為長春澱。

translations.literal: On dingchou, the Pian Forest at the Yutian County traveling palace was made the Imperial Forest, and Great Marsh Lake was named Changchun Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou the Pian Forest at the Yutian traveling palace became the Imperial Forest, and Great Marsh Lake was renamed Changchun Marsh.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，還都。

translations.literal: Second month, on dingwei, he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingwei, he returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 三月癸丑朔，萬春節，宋、高麗、夏遣使來賀。

translations.literal: Third month, on guichou at the new moon, Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Xia sent envoys to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guichou at the new moon, the Wan Spring Festival; Song, Goryeo, and Western Xia sent congratulatory envoys.

sentences.zh: 己未，詔凡犯罪被問之官，雖遇赦，不得複職。

translations.literal: On jiwei, an edict ruled that any official who had been questioned for crime, though amnestied, might not return to office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei an edict barred officials under criminal inquiry from returning to office even after amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以新定猛安謀克，詔免中都、西京、河北、山東、河東、陝西路去年租稅。

translations.literal: On yichou, because the meng'an and mouke had been newly fixed, an edict remitted last year's land tax and levies in the Central Capital, Western Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Hedong, and Shaanxi circuits.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, with meng'an and mouke newly reorganized, last year's taxes were waived in the Central Capital, Western Capital, Hebei, Shandong, Hedong, and Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以平章政事徒單克甯為尚書右丞相，御史大夫烏古論元忠為平章政事。

translations.literal: On xinsi, Administration Councillor Tushan Kening was made Right Chancellor of the Secretariat, and Censor-in-Chief Wugulun Yuanzhong was made administration councillor.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Administration Councillor Tushan Kening became right chancellor, and Censor-in-Chief Wugulun Yuanzhong administration councillor.

sentences.zh: 四月丁亥，定冒廕罪賞。

translations.literal: Fourth month, on dinghai, rewards and punishments for false inheritance of yin privilege were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month, on dinghai, penalties and rewards for fraudulent yin inheritance were set.

sentences.zh: 己亥，制宗室及外並一品命婦，衣服聽用明金。

translations.literal: On jihai, a regulation allowed imperial clansmen and first-rank titled ladies of the outer court to use bright gold on their clothing.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai imperial clansmen and outer-court ladies of the first rank were permitted bright-gold ornament on dress.

sentences.zh: 以西上閣門使郭喜國為橫賜高麗使。

translations.literal: Western Upper Gate Commissioner Guo Xiguo was made side-gift envoy to Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Western Upper Gate Commissioner Guo Xiguo was sent as side-gift envoy to Goryeo.

sentences.zh: 太甯宮火。

translations.literal: Taining Palace caught fire.
translations.idiomatic: Taining Palace burned.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，上謂宰臣曰：「女直官多謂朕食用太儉，朕謂不然。

translations.literal: On yisi, the emperor told the chief ministers: "Many Jurchen officials say my food and drink are too frugal, but I do not think so.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi he told the chief ministers: "Many Jurchen officers say I eat and drink too plainly, but I disagree.

sentences.zh: 夫一食多費，豈為美事。

translations.literal: For one meal to cost much—how is that a fine thing?
translations.idiomatic: A lavish meal is no virtue.

sentences.zh: 況朕年高，不欲屠宰物命。

translations.literal: Moreover, I am old and do not wish to slaughter living creatures.
translations.idiomatic: Besides, I am old and wish to spare animal life.

sentences.zh: 貴為天子，能自節約，亦不惡也。

translations.literal: Though exalted as Son of Heaven, to restrain oneself is not a bad thing.
translations.idiomatic: Even as Son of Heaven, self-restraint is no shame.

sentences.zh: 朕服禦或舊，常使浣濯，至於破碎，方始更易。

translations.literal: My robes are sometimes old; I have them washed until worn to tatters before I replace them.
translations.idiomatic: I often wear old robes, have them washed until they fray, and only then replace them.

sentences.zh: 向時帳幕常用塗金為飾，今則不爾，但令足用，何必事紛華也。

translations.literal: Formerly tent curtains were often adorned with gilding; now I do not do so, but only make them adequate—why must one pursue extravagance?"
translations.idiomatic: Once our tent hangings were gilded; now I forgo that and ask only what serves—why chase ornament?"

sentences.zh: 」庚戌，如金蓮川。

translations.literal: " On gengxu, he went to Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: " On gengxu he went to Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，京師地震，生黑白毛。

translations.literal: Fifth month, on bingyin, the capital was shaken by earthquake, and black and white fibers issued from the ground.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin, the capital quaked and black and white filaments sprouted from the earth.

sentences.zh: 七月，旱。

translations.literal: Seventh month, drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month there was drought.

sentences.zh: 八月壬午，秋獵。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on renwu, the autumn hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on renwu, the autumn hunt began.

sentences.zh: 九月壬戌，至自金蓮川。

translations.literal: Ninth month, on renxu, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on renxu, he returned from Golden Lotus Stream.

sentences.zh: 乙太府監李佾等為賀宋生日使，少府少監賽補為夏國生日使。

translations.literal: On yiyou, Director of the Grand Treasury Li Yi and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday; Assistant Director of the Imperial Workshops Sai Bu was envoy for the Western Xia ruler's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou Director of the Grand Treasury Li Yi and others were sent to congratulate Song on the emperor's birthday; Assistant Director Sai Bu of the Imperial Workshops was envoy for the Xia ruler's birthday.

sentences.zh: 丙子，蒲速宛群牧老忽謀叛，伏誅。

translations.literal: On bingzi, Laohu of the Pusuwans herd office plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi Laohu of the Pusuwans herd office plotted rebellion and was put to death.

sentences.zh: 十月庚辰朔，更定銓注縣令丞簿格。

translations.literal: Tenth month, on gengchen at the new moon, standards for examining and appointing county magistrates, assistants, and clerks were revised.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month, on gengchen at the new moon, standards for examining and appointing county magistrates, deputies, and registrars were revised.

sentences.zh: 詔西北路招討司每進馬駝鷹鶻等，輒率斂部內，自今並罷之。

translations.literal: An edict ruled that whenever the Northwest Route Pacification Commission presented horses, camels, hawks, and falcons, it had levied the tribes within; from now on this was altogether abolished.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ended the Northwest Route Pacification Commission's practice of levying its tribes whenever it presented horses, camels, hawks, and falcons.

sentences.zh: 壬午，上謂宰臣曰：「察問細微，非人君之體，朕亦知之。

translations.literal: On renwu, the emperor told the chief ministers: "To inquire into minute matters is not the manner of a ruler, and I know this.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he told the chief ministers: "Prying into trifles ill suits a ruler, and I know it.

sentences.zh: 然以卿等殊不用心，故時或察問。

translations.literal: However, because you all are especially negligent in effort, I therefore sometimes make inquiries.
translations.idiomatic: But you have been quite remiss; that is why I sometimes inquire myself.

sentences.zh: 如山后之地，皆為親王、公主、權勢之家所占，轉和於民，皆由卿等之不察。

translations.literal: Lands such as those in the mountain rear have all been occupied by princes, princesses, and powerful houses and resold to the people—all through your failure to oversee.
translations.idiomatic: Lands in the Shanhou region have all been seized by princes, princesses, and powerful clans and resold to commoners—all because you failed to look into it.

sentences.zh: 卿等當盡心勤事，毋令朕之煩勞也。

translations.literal: You must all serve with full heart and diligence and not let me be vexed with toil.
translations.idiomatic: Serve with all your heart and do not leave this toil to me.

sentences.zh: 」詔徙遙落河、移馬河兩猛安於大名、東平等路安置。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered the two meng'an of Yaoluo River and Yima River relocated and settled on the Daming and Dongping circuits.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict ordered the Yaoluo River and Yima River meng'an resettled in the Daming and Dongping routes.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，上謂宰臣曰：「凡人在下位，欲冀升進，勉為公廉賢肖何以知之。

translations.literal: On wuxu, the emperor told the chief ministers: "All men in lower rank who hope for promotion and strive to be public-spirited, incorrupt, and worthy—how may one know them?
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu he told the chief ministers: "Men in low office who hope to rise and strive to seem upright and worthy—how can one know them?

sentences.zh: 及其通顯，觀其施為，方見本心。

translations.literal: When they reach conspicuous rank and one observes their conduct, only then does their true heart appear.
translations.idiomatic: Only when they reach high office and one watches their deeds does their true bent show.

sentences.zh: 如招討哲典，初任定州同知，繼為都司，未嘗少有私徇，所至皆有清名，及為招討，不固守。

translations.literal: Take Pacification Commissioner Zhedian: at first deputy commissioner of Dingzhou, then director of the metropolitan office—never the least private favoritism; wherever he went he had a clean name; but when made Pacification Commissioner, he did not hold firm.
translations.idiomatic: Take Pacification Commissioner Zhedian: as deputy commissioner at Dingzhou and then in the metropolitan directorate he never showed private bias and won a clean name everywhere; yet as Pacification Commissioner he did not stand firm.

sentences.zh: 人心險於山川，誠難知也。

translations.literal: The human heart is more treacherous than mountains and rivers—truly hard to know."
translations.idiomatic: Hearts are more treacherous than mountains and rivers—indeed they are hard to know."

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，上謂宰臣曰：「近覽《資治通鑒》，編次累代廢興，甚有鑒戒，司馬光用心如此，古之良史無以加也。

translations.literal: " On renzi the emperor told the chief ministers: "I have lately read the Comprehensive Mirror; its arrangement of rise and fall through the ages is full of warning. Sima Guang gave such care to it—no ancient good historian could surpass it.
translations.idiomatic: " On renzi he told the chief ministers: "I have been reading the Comprehensive Mirror to Arrange Governance; its account of dynastic rise and fall is full of warning. Sima Guang took such pains with it that no historian of old could match him.

sentences.zh: 校書郎毛麾，朕屢問以事，善於應對，真該博老儒，可除太常職事，以備討論。

translations.literal: Proofreader Mao Hui—I have often questioned him on affairs and he answers well; he is truly a learned elder scholar and may be made to ritual duties at the Ministry of Rites to join in discussion."
translations.idiomatic: Proofreader Mao Hui I have often consulted; he replies ably. A truly learned elder—let him be given ritual office in the Ministry of Rites for our deliberations."

sentences.zh: 」甲辰，以殿前都點檢襄為御史大夫。

translations.literal: " On jiachen, Palace Front Commander Xiang was made Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiachen Palace Front Commander Xiang became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁巳，尚書右丞移剌道罷。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on dingsi, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat Yela Dao was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingsi, Right Vice Director Yela Dao left office.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，以真定尹單守素等為賀宋正旦使。

translations.literal: On yichou, Zhending prefect Tushan Shousu and others were made envoys to congratulate Song on New Year's Day.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou Zhending prefect Tushan Shousu and others were sent as envoys to congratulate Song on the new year.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，以御史大夫襄為尚書右丞。

translations.literal: On guiyou, Censor-in-Chief Xiang was made Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Censor-in-Chief Xiang became right vice director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，上諭宰臣曰：「郡守選人，資考雖未及，廉能者則升用之，以勵其餘。

translations.literal: On yihai, the emperor instructed the chief ministers: "In choosing prefects, even if service seniority is not yet met, the incorrupt and capable are to be promoted to stir the rest.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai he instructed the chief ministers: "In appointing prefects, even when seniority is short, promote the honest and able to stir the rest.

sentences.zh: 」乙太常少卿任倜為高麗生日使。

translations.literal: " Junior Director of Rites Ren Ti was made envoy for Goryeo's birthday.
translations.idiomatic: " Junior Director of Rites Ren Ti was sent as envoy for Goryeo's birthday.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛巳，上謂宰臣曰：「岐國用人，但一言合意便升用之，一言之失便責罰之。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on xinsi, the emperor told the chief ministers: "The Prince of Qi used men—one agreeable word and he promoted them; one slip of the tongue and he punished them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on xinsi, he told the chief ministers: "Hailing used men—one pleasing word won promotion, one misstep brought punishment.

sentences.zh: 凡人言辭，一得一失，賢者不免。

translations.literal: In human speech there is gain and loss alike—even the worthy cannot escape it.
translations.idiomatic: In speech everyone gains and loses—even the worthy are not exempt.

sentences.zh: 自古用人鹹試以事，若止以奏對之間，安能知人賢否？

translations.literal: From antiquity men have always been tried by deeds; if one relies only on answers at court audience, how can one know who is worthy or not?
translations.idiomatic: From antiquity men have been tested by deeds; if one judges only by answers at court, how can one know who is fit?

sentences.zh: 朕之取人，眾所與者用之，不以獨見為是也。

translations.literal: In my choosing of men I employ those the many commend and do not hold my private view alone correct."
translations.idiomatic: In choosing men I use those the many recommend and do not treat my private view alone as right."

sentences.zh: 」己亥，河決衛州。

translations.literal: " On jihai the Yellow River burst its banks at Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: " On jihai the Yellow River broke through at Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，獵於近郊。

translations.literal: On xinchou, he hunted in the near suburbs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou he hunted near the capital.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，特授襲封衍聖公孔總兗州曲阜令，封爵如故。

translations.literal: On guimao, Kong Zong, hereditary Duke Yansheng, was specially granted magistrate of Qufu in Yanzhou; his title remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Kong Zong, hereditary Duke Yansheng, was specially appointed magistrate of Qufu in Yanzhou, his noble rank unchanged.
